kul-p01-v1.quick_english: Pārvatī asked the supreme lord, the supreme bliss.

kul-p01-v2.quick_english: All-knowing, easily won by devotion, and loving to those who take refuge.

kul-p01-v3.quick_english: In worthless and terrible samsara, beings are stained by all sorrow.

kul-p01-v4.quick_english: They are born and die, and for them liberation does not exist.

kul-p01-v5.quick_english: By what means, O lord of gods, is one liberated? Speak to me, O lord.

kul-p01-v6.quick_english: By hearing it alone, a man is liberated from samsara.

kul-p01-v7.quick_english: All-knowing, all-doer, all-lord, stainless, and nondual.

kul-p01-v8.quick_english: Without qualities, existence-consciousness-bliss; its parts are called jiva.

kul-p01-v9.quick_english: Divided by womb and other conditions, by actions and organs and the like.

kul-p01-v10.quick_english: That body endowed with this and that birth, and life and enjoyment, are born of action.

kul-p01-v11.quick_english: The subtle linga body, imperishable after liberation, O dear one.

kul-p01-v12.quick_english: Celestial beings and liberated ones proceed in order.

kul-p01-v13.quick_english: A human, having become a knower by good deeds, obtains liberation if knowledge is present.

kul-p01-v14.quick_english: Truth-knowledge is not obtained without humanity.

kul-p01-v15.quick_english: A creature sometimes obtains human birth through accumulated merit.

kul-p01-v16.quick_english: Who is more sinful here than one who does not save himself?

kul-p01-v17.quick_english: One who does not know his own benefit becomes a self-killer.

kul-p01-v18.quick_english: Therefore, having obtained the wealth of a body, one should accomplish meritorious actions.

kul-p01-v19.quick_english: One should strive in protection until truth is seen.

kul-p01-v20.quick_english: Auspicious and inauspicious action does not make the body recur again and again.

kul-p01-v21.quick_english: Even those afflicted by leprosy do not desire to abandon the body.

kul-p01-v22.quick_english: Knowledge for meditation yoga soon liberates him.

kul-p01-v23.quick_english: Who else will save the self as a benefactor?

kul-p01-v24.quick_english: Having gone to a place without medicine, what will a diseased person do?

kul-p01-v25.quick_english: As long as this body stands, practice truth so long.

kul-p02-v26.quick_english: Diseases kill like enemies; therefore one should practice the good.

kul-p02-v27.quick_english: As long as there is no impairment of the senses, one should practice the good.

kul-p02-v28.quick_english: A creature attached to pleasure and pain does not know what benefits itself.

kul-p02-v29.quick_english: The world, having drunk the wine of delusion, never fears.

kul-p02-v30.quick_english: Life is unsteady like lightning; whose world could have steadiness?

kul-p02-v31.quick_english: Childhood, disease, old age, and sufferings make even half of life fruitless.

kul-p02-v32.quick_english: Why is one not killed by killers in a place of fear?

kul-p02-v33.quick_english: How do the fearless stand in an impermanent, unpleasant world?

kul-p02-v34.quick_english: A wealth-knower brings harm and does not know his own death.

kul-p02-v35.quick_english: Even while reading, one does not know, deluded by your māyā.

kul-p02-v36.quick_english: In the grasp of death, disease, and old age, one understands nothing at all.

kul-p02-v37.quick_english: Like a broken raw pot in water, it is not thought to endure.

kul-p02-v38.quick_english: The binding of waves is not a support that fits in life.

kul-p02-v39.quick_english: Devi, when ocean water dries in the body, what tale remains?

kul-p02-v40.quick_english: Time, like a wolf, forcibly kills the mortal who chatters.

kul-p02-v41.quick_english: Thus death eats people who are endowed with effort, dear one.

kul-p02-v42.quick_english: Death does not wait, whether something is done or not done.

kul-p02-v43.quick_english: You know death as an enemy; why do you not see it coming?

kul-p02-v44.quick_english: Death eats the man cooked in the fire of passion and hatred.

kul-p02-v45.quick_english: Death harms all; thus this created world is mortal.

kul-p02-v46.quick_english: Since destruction pursues all, therefore one should practice the good.

kul-p02-v47.quick_english: From greed for another's wife and wealth, life-decay may occur for men.

kul-p02-v48.quick_english: Life-decay for men may arise from non-restraint of the senses.

kul-p02-v49.quick_english: Creatures go to death, which is seen as sleep.

kul-p02-v50.quick_english: Having obtained the supreme portion, one abandons the former body.

kul-p03-v51.quick_english: Thus attainment of another body is like one who has arrived from one house to another.

kul-p03-v52.quick_english: Elsewhere, O goddess, the ignorant ones go and come again and again.

kul-p03-v53.quick_english: The fruit of a tree whose root is watered is seen on its branches.

kul-p03-v54.quick_english: These are the fruits of the tree of self-offense for embodied beings.

kul-p03-v55.quick_english: From association even a knower necessarily wavers; what then of one with little knowledge?

kul-p03-v56.quick_english: He should associate with good people; indeed association with the good is medicine.

kul-p03-v57.quick_english: Whose guide is not present, he is blind; how would he not be a pathless goer?

kul-p03-v58.quick_english: So many sorrow-arrows enter his heart.

kul-p03-v59.quick_english: Woman, mother, father, son, and so on—by what cause is this connection?

kul-p03-v60.quick_english: Dear one, he who has performed renunciation is happy, not another.

kul-p03-v61.quick_english: Dear one, one should avoid samsara, the abode of all sins.

kul-p03-v62.quick_english: O goddess, for minds attached to samsara, cutting without a weapon.

kul-p03-v63.quick_english: Therefore, abandoning samsara and being devoted to truth, one may be happy.

kul-p03-v64.quick_english: One attached to woman, wealth, and the like is never liberated.

kul-p03-v65.quick_english: Like water in an unripe pot, they perish by limb only.

kul-p03-v66.quick_english: Alas, sense-object foods devour through body-seated sense thieves.

kul-p03-v67.quick_english: Thus the pleasure-greedy embodied one does not see yama's affliction.

kul-p03-v68.quick_english: Dear one, those devoted to filling the belly, being unwise, are hellish.

kul-p03-v69.quick_english: Dear one, the knower is called man, the knowledge-less beast.

kul-p03-v70.quick_english: Dear one, at night men are afflicted by love and sleep.

kul-p03-v71.quick_english: Alas, ignorance-deluded beings are born and die.

kul-p03-v72.quick_english: O Parvati, fools do not know supreme truth and perish.

kul-p03-v73.quick_english: Selves joined with ignorance wander as deceivers.

kul-p03-v74.quick_english: Deluded by mantra utterance, oblation, etc., and sacrifice extensions.

kul-p03-v75.quick_english: Fools deluded by your maya desire the hidden.

kul-p04-v76.quick_english: Goddess, is the great serpent dead from striking the anthill?

kul-p04-v77.quick_english: Knowers wander in the world and delude people too.

kul-p04-v78.quick_english: Abandon him who has fallen from both karma and brahman, as an outcaste.

kul-p04-v79.quick_english: Those who go like donkeys and others—are they yogins?

kul-p04-v80.quick_english: Are vulgar earth-and-ash wearers liberated indeed?

kul-p04-v81.quick_english: Goddess, are those who chase gold and deer yogins?

kul-p04-v82.quick_english: Are those vow-keepers who are like frogs and fish true vow-keepers?

kul-p04-v83.quick_english: Goddess, are those who stand before people wise indeed?

kul-p04-v84.quick_english: Are those who do not drink earth-water yogins?

kul-p04-v85.quick_english: Are those who stand like boars and others yogins?

kul-p04-v86.quick_english: Mistress of kula, direct knowledge of truth is the cause of liberation.

kul-p04-v87.quick_english: Those bound by beast-bonds do not know ultimate truth.

kul-p04-v88.quick_english: How indeed do those grasped by time and death stand?

kul-p04-v89.quick_english: All of an imitator's speech is crow-speech.

kul-p04-v90.quick_english: Goddess, they recite day and night yet are turned away from supreme truth.

kul-p04-v91.quick_english: Distressed fools with agitated senses stand by thought.

kul-p04-v92.quick_english: They explain scripture's existence otherwise, and otherwise.

kul-p04-v93.quick_english: Some are slain by ego and deprived of instruction.

kul-p04-v94.quick_english: They do not know supreme truth, as a ladle does not know cooking juice.

kul-p04-v95.quick_english: They recite veda-scriptures; a knower of bhava is rare.

kul-p04-v96.quick_english: An evil-minded cowherd sees a goat in a thicket as in a well.

kul-p04-v97.quick_english: Darkness never turns back by lamp-news.

kul-p04-v98.quick_english: Goddess, for the wise, scripture is the cause of truth-knowledge.

kul-p04-v99.quick_english: Men famed by qualities such as true knowledge, giving, and heroism.

kul-p04-v100.quick_english: Thus those deluded by scripture stand far away; no doubt.

kul-p05-v101.quick_english: O goddess, one with a thousand-year lifespan does not indeed reach the end of the scriptures.

kul-p05-v102.quick_english: Therefore one should discern the essence, just as a swan separates milk from water.

kul-p05-v103.quick_english: Like a person seeking grain discards the chaff, one should set aside all the scriptures.

kul-p05-v104.quick_english: O Goddess, for one who knows the truth, there is no further need of scripture.

kul-p05-v105.quick_english: O Goddess venerated by heroes, liberation comes only from knowledge, and in no other way.

kul-p05-v106.quick_english: In the same way, all the scriptures have knowledge alone as their cause.

kul-p05-v107.quick_english: From this toil of carrying a load of wood, there is one supreme, life-giving thing.

kul-p05-v108.quick_english: It is obtained through the mouth of the guru, and not otherwise, not even by millions of scriptures.

kul-p05-v109.quick_english: Sound-brahman consists of the scriptures, but the supreme brahman is born of discrimination.

kul-p05-v110.quick_english: They know my truth as free from both duality and non-duality.

kul-p05-v111.quick_english: A creature is bound by the thought 'this is mine' and released by the thought 'this is not mine'.

kul-p05-v112.quick_english: Other actions, other kinds of knowledge, and skill in crafts lead only to toil.

kul-p05-v113.quick_english: As long as there is restlessness of the senses, so long, whence is discourse on truth?

kul-p05-v114.quick_english: As long as the mind lacks steadiness, truth-discourse is impossible.

kul-p05-v115.quick_english: As long as guru compassion is absent, truth-discourse is absent.

kul-p05-v116.quick_english: As long as truth is not found, veda-scripture-agama discourse remains empty.

kul-p05-v117.quick_english: One may become devoted to truth, goddess, if one desires liberation of the self.

kul-p05-v118.quick_english: Burnt by the three afflictions, one should seek the shade of the liberation tree.

kul-p05-v119.quick_english: Without kula-dharma there is no release; this is truth, no doubt.

kul-p05-v120.quick_english: Easily, goddess, one is released from terrible samsara bondage.

kul-p05-v121.quick_english: In brief, kuleshani, what more do you desire to hear?

kul-p05-v122.quick_english: Establishment-discourse is named the first illumination.

kul-p05-v123.quick_english: Kula-dharma, god, has been hinted by you, not revealed.

kul-p05-v124.quick_english: Speak to me, supreme lord, if your compassion is in me.

kul-p05-v125.quick_english: By merely hearing it, one may become dear to the yoginis.

kul-p06-v126.quick_english: I speak to you from affection; listen with a one-pointed mind.

kul-p06-v127.quick_english: It is unspeakable in the ultimate sense, yet nevertheless I speak it to you.

kul-p06-v128.quick_english: It should be given to a devotee or disciple; otherwise there would be a fall.

kul-p06-v129.quick_english: Better than Vaiṣṇava is Śaiva; better than Śaiva is the dakṣiṇa best.

kul-p06-v130.quick_english: Better than siddhānta is Kaula; nothing is higher than Kaula indeed.

kul-p06-v131.quick_english: O goddess, Kula, directly giving Śiva, has passed from ear to ear.

kul-p06-v132.quick_english: By me, knower of essence, O goddess, the Kula dharma has been extracted.

kul-p06-v133.quick_english: On one side is Kula dharma; there, beloved, Kaula is greater.

kul-p06-v134.quick_english: Thus also various dharmas have entered; indeed it is Kula.

kul-p06-v135.quick_english: And all views, beloved, are indeed Kula, thus.

kul-p06-v136.quick_english: Then, by Kula dharma, another samaya would be equal.

kul-p06-v137.quick_english: Thus also all samayas are not equal by Kula dharma.

kul-p06-v138.quick_english: Thus there is a great difference between kula and any other samaya.

kul-p06-v139.quick_english: Even so, the same dharma is never found through kula.

kul-p06-v140.quick_english: Bound by the noose of saṃsāra, he becomes beloved among those who abandon.

kul-p06-v141.quick_english: He obtains sin greater than brahmin-killing, without doubt.

kul-p06-v142.quick_english: Having gone to another island beyond heaven, one enjoys the jewel of liberation.

kul-p06-v143.quick_english: But kaulas obtain liberation immediately, without doubt.

kul-p06-v144.quick_english: There is no dharma equal to kaula; I swear to you, kula-nāyikā.

kul-p06-v145.quick_english: Kaula is the essence of enjoyment-yoga; therefore, beloved, it is greater than all.

kul-p06-v146.quick_english: And saṃsāra becomes liberation in kula dharma, O kula-lady.

kul-p06-v147.quick_english: Devoted to kula dharma, O goddess, among humans what need is there to say more?

kul-p06-v148.quick_english: One should indeed know kula, if one desires siddhi of the self.

kul-p06-v149.quick_english: Instruction and the like without kula are like a conviction risen from a dream.

kul-p06-v150.quick_english: That indeed the creature obtains; instruction is useless.

kul-p07-v151.quick_english: For one whose mind is purified as if by mantra, the knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p07-v152.quick_english: And those who are established in the dharma of Kula are all non-returning.

kul-p07-v153.quick_english: O Goddess, the knowledge of Kula shines forth in people whose sins have been exhausted.

kul-p07-v154.quick_english: And through devotion to the deity and the guru, the knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p07-v155.quick_english: For one who is extremely devoted to the secret, the knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p07-v156.quick_english: For whoever has firm devotion, the knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p07-v157.quick_english: Kula knowledge is obtained through observances that fulfill the guru's command.

kul-p07-v158.quick_english: Therefore, after examining the recipient, the Kula knowledge spoken by me should be taught.

kul-p07-v159.quick_english: Whoever breaks the command would incur the curse of the deity.

history.gloss: Whoever breaks the command would incur the curse of the deity.

kul-p07-v160.quick_english: That guru and that disciple would become bound beings before the yoginis.

kul-p07-v161.quick_english: Both of them would directly attain the meeting of the yoginis and heroes.

kul-p07-v162.quick_english: Having known this Kula dharma, one is liberated; there is no doubt about this.

kul-p07-v163.quick_english: Therefore, without delay and without doubt, one should take refuge in the Kaula way.

history.gloss: Therefore, without delay and without doubt, one should take refuge in the Kaula way.

kul-p07-v164.quick_english: O Parvati, abandoning milk-rice in one's own house to beg and wander is foolish.

history.gloss: O Parvati, abandoning milk-rice in one's own house to beg and wander is foolish.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p07-v165.quick_english: Having abandoned a jewel in hand, one foolishly desires distant glass.

kul-p07-v166.quick_english: He abandons a heap of grain and wishes to grasp a heap of dust.

kul-p07-v167.quick_english: Thirst-afflicted, he runs toward a mirage as if from a pond.

kul-p07-v168.quick_english: O Kula leader, other systems are not such as glorious Kaula.

history.gloss: O Kula leader, other systems are not such as glorious Kaula.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p07-v169.quick_english: He wishes to cross the boundless far shore with his hands.

kul-p07-v170.quick_english: With dream-gained wealth indeed, he would become wealthy then.

kul-p07-v171.quick_english: So from other systems, enjoyment and liberation shine forth.

history.gloss: So from other systems, enjoyment and liberation shine forth.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p07-v172.quick_english: O Kula ladies, one steadfast in Kula is the vessel of enjoyment and liberation.

kul-p07-v173.quick_english: He too attains a good goal; how much more his devoted follower.

kul-p07-v174.quick_english: Honored, he honors quickly; therefore do not abandon him.

kul-p07-v175.quick_english: Let people laugh at me; let kings punish me.

kul-p08-v176.quick_english: I will not abandon your dharma by mind, speech, body, or action.

kul-p08-v177.quick_english: He is worshipped by the gods there and becomes Shiva.

kul-p08-v178.quick_english: Whoever worships you with devotion obtains a good destination.

kul-p08-v179.quick_english: Whether death comes today or at the end of an age, one must never abandon kula.

history.gloss: Whether death comes today or at the end of an age, one must never abandon kula.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p08-v180.quick_english: One must not abandon kula-dharma from desire or even from fear.

history.gloss: One must not abandon kula-dharma from desire or even from fear.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p08-v181.quick_english: One suffers from the very moment of birth, by the bhuta enemy and the enemy within.

kul-p08-v182.quick_english: Like bubbles in water, those who are averse to kaula are fleeting.

kul-p08-v183.quick_english: He truly lives whose mind is established in kula-dharma.

kul-p08-v184.quick_english: Though he breathes like a blacksmith's bellows, he does not truly live.

history.gloss: Though he breathes like a blacksmith's bellows, he does not truly live.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p08-v185.quick_english: O Kuleshvari, the life of one ignorant of kula-command is like that of a beast.

kul-p08-v186.quick_english: Whether a vow-holder or not, a person averse to kaula is disqualified.

kul-p08-v187.quick_english: O goddess, devoted to kula-dharma; the rest are gate-donkeys.

kul-p08-v188.quick_english: The other is the supreme truth, covered by bone and skin.

history.gloss: The other is the supreme truth, covered by bone and skin.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p08-v189.quick_english: Even a dog-cooker who knows kula surpasses a brahmin.

kul-p08-v190.quick_english: O goddess, this one devoted to kula worship is kaula, not others.

kul-p08-v191.quick_english: Shame on him; his life is like a crow's.

kul-p08-v192.quick_english: O goddess, for those by fortune, kula-knowledge shines.

history.gloss: O goddess, for those by fortune, kula-knowledge shines.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p08-v193.quick_english: For those in whose mind arises the kula-knowledge spoken by me.

history.gloss: For those in whose mind arises the kula-knowledge spoken by me.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p08-v194.quick_english: All sacrifice practice is entry into kula dharma.

kul-p08-v195.quick_english: They never again enter the mother's womb.

history.gloss: They never again enter the mother's womb.
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p08-v196.quick_english: O Kuleshani, kula-knowledge has no need of other dharmas.

kul-p08-v197.quick_english: I give supreme knowledge at the end time; there is no doubt.

kul-p08-v198.quick_english: Kula gives all fruits easily; alas, who abandons it?

history.gloss: Kula gives all fruits easily; alas, who abandons it?
history.reason: de-overlapped token run: stripped redundant suffix repeats from compound surfaces (count-preserving, T1-only); align gate repair 2026-11-13

kul-p08-v199.quick_english: Even one knowing veda, shastra, and agama is ignorant without kula knowledge.

kul-p08-v200.quick_english: Only cakora birds know the beauty of the moon-rays; no others do.

kul-p09-v201.quick_english: Small rivers swell by moonlight; what of the ocean?

kul-p09-v202.quick_english: Bees greedy for other flowers are servants of mandāra fragrance.

kul-p09-v203.quick_english: Śiva holds a lotus on his head; Rāhu's descendant swallows it—alas.

kul-p09-v204.quick_english: A crane drinks milk mixed with water; what does it know like a swan?

kul-p09-v205.quick_english: Therefore kaula is supreme over all; how can it be common to all?

kul-p09-v206.quick_english: Whoever makes a difference among them cuts my limb.

kul-p09-v207.quick_english: Therefore know, beloved, that scripture is veda-natured and kaula-natured.

kul-p09-v208.quick_english: In this kula, beloved, the deity gives bliss and liberation to men.

kul-p09-v209.quick_english: Kula attains authority because it gives direct fruit.

kul-p09-v210.quick_english: By the power of perception, all doubters of it are slain.

kul-p09-v211.quick_english: Or that direct fruit-giving itself is the best vision.

kul-p09-v212.quick_english: Thus thinking, great goddess, I have investigated kaula.

kul-p09-v213.quick_english: The Kula way is reviled by ignorant bound beings who do not recognize it.

kul-p09-v214.quick_english: For him, neither the guru's compassion nor knowledge of Kula arises.

kul-p09-v215.quick_english: Thus, deluded by me, they do not know your Kula.

kul-p09-v216.quick_english: And people always pursue things whose fruits are nothing but vain effort.

kul-p09-v217.quick_english: Alas, alas, fools revile your vision, which is dear to me.

kul-p09-v218.quick_english: Those who are vainly proud of their knowledge do not know the Kula way.

kul-p09-v219.quick_english: Indeed, taking another form, it is for the delusion of the wicked.

kul-p09-v220.quick_english: And for them there is no progress, even in hundreds of crores of ages.

kul-p09-v221.quick_english: Even when restrained, a meritorious person still resorts to Kula alone.

kul-p09-v222.quick_english: Sages, lords of yogis, and others have attained the highest supreme accomplishment.

kul-p09-v223.quick_english: Those who truly serve the Kaula way are great and exceedingly rare.

history.gloss: Those who truly serve the Kaula way are great and exceedingly rare.

kul-p78-v1943.quick_english: Dust from the sadhya's foot, together with pyre ash, is also used.

kul-p78-v1944.quick_english: One should hang the well-established-breath object above the pit.

kul-p78-v1945.quick_english: With impure mind, fierce gaze, and intolerant disposition, one proceeds.

kul-p78-v1946.quick_english: The best knower of mantra offers those substances according to rite, O Devi.

kul-p78-v1947.quick_english: For peace, O Devi, one should contemplate a sattvic white form.

kul-p78-v1948.quick_english: For cruel acts, one should contemplate a tamasic black form.

kul-p78-v1949.quick_english: Whoever acts otherwise from delusion becomes a deity-beast.

kul-p78-v1950.quick_english: Having done acts, one should not do otherwise, O hero-honored one.

kul-p79-v1951.quick_english: That seed, called Parāprāsāda, has a radiance equal to the fire at the end of a cosmic age.

kul-p79-v1952.quick_english: It is itself equal to the fire of time and terrifying to all beings.

kul-p79-v1953.quick_english: The one named Parāprāsāda is accompanied by youthful exuberance.

kul-p79-v1954.quick_english: It targets beings who do harm and those who cause quarrels and trouble.

kul-p79-v1955.quick_english: It targets spirits, possessing entities, vetālas, piśācas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas.

kul-p79-v1956.quick_english: In an instant they go to destruction, like moths in a fire.

kul-p79-v1957.quick_english: O Goddess, by this meditation one may destroy even time and other such forces.

kul-p79-v1958.quick_english: O Lady of Kula, I have spoken in brief; what more do you wish to hear?

kul-p79-v1959.quick_english: This is the sixteenth chapter, named the discourse on desire-driven rites.

kul-p79-v1960.quick_english: O Supreme Lord, tell me the truth of the principles of Kula.

kul-p79-v1961.quick_english: By merely hearing it, knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p79-v1962.quick_english: Having assumed many forms for the perfect descent of knowledge...

kul-p79-v1963.quick_english: To consciousness, the radiance that breaks all ignorance-darkness, and.

kul-p79-v1964.quick_english: Here and hereafter also, to devotees and auspicious ones, the state-giver.

kul-p79-v1965.quick_english: Always establish your servitude in the form of true consciousness.

kul-p79-v1966.quick_english: Because of darkness-removal, he is called guru.

kul-p79-v1967.quick_english: The u-syllable, Viṣṇu, the guru, the supreme.

kul-p79-v1968.quick_english: The u-syllable, śiva-identity, is called guru.

kul-p79-v1969.quick_english: Because of rudra and deity form, he is called guru.

kul-p79-v1970.quick_english: He gathers scripture-meanings here; therefore he is called ācārya.

kul-p79-v1971.quick_english: Because of yama and yoga perfection, he is called ācārya.

kul-p79-v1972.quick_english: Because of one-pointed meditation mind, he is called ārādhya.

kul-p79-v1973.quick_english: Because of compassion-filled form, he is called deśika, dear.

kul-p79-v1974.quick_english: Because of absence of false knowledge, he is called svāmī, dear.

kul-p79-v1975.quick_english: Maheśvara is so called because of his similarity to beings from the dog onward and because of delight.

kul-p80-v1976.quick_english: Because the sign of ignorance is hidden, he is called Śrīnātha, dear one.

kul-p80-v1977.quick_english: Because he subjugates the lives of the world, he is called Deva.

kul-p80-v1978.quick_english: Because of protection and loveliness, he is called Bhaṭṭāraka.

kul-p80-v1979.quick_english: Because he gives enjoyment and liberation, he is called Prabhu.

kul-p80-v1980.quick_english: Because he is worshiped by the gods, he is called Yogī, dear one.

kul-p80-v1981.quick_english: Because of mutual self-binding, he is called Saṃyamī.

kul-p80-v1982.quick_english: Because he accepts auspicious acts, he is called Tapasvī.

kul-p80-v1983.quick_english: Because the meaning of 'that thou art' is realized, he is called Avadhūta.

kul-p80-v1984.quick_english: Because he is distant from rajas and tamas, he is called Vīra.

kul-p80-v1985.quick_english: He by whom there is knowledge of liberation is called Kaulika.

kul-p80-v1986.quick_english: Because of inquiry into kula and akula, the skillful ones are Kaulikas, dear one.

kul-p80-v1987.quick_english: Because of discipline of the sense organs, he is called Sādhaka.

kul-p80-v1988.quick_english: The devotee is thus spoken of as crossing all sufferings.

kul-p80-v1989.quick_english: The disciple is called one who learns yoga from gurus.

kul-p80-v1990.quick_english: The yoginī is called from dissolution of adjunct glory.

kul-p80-v1991.quick_english: Śakti is called from giving intense liberation.

kul-p80-v1992.quick_english: Thus called is my principle, dear one.

kul-p80-v1993.quick_english: Japa is called from manifestation of supreme god.

kul-p80-v1994.quick_english: Stotra is called from delivering praisers, goddess.

kul-p80-v1995.quick_english: Meditation is mind contemplation of the desired deity.

kul-p80-v1996.quick_english: Foot is called from nature of man and woman, dear one.

kul-p80-v1997.quick_english: Veda is called from being authority of perceptions.

kul-p80-v1998.quick_english: Purāṇa is called from generating nine devotions and so on.

kul-p80-v1999.quick_english: Scripture is called from delivering from all sins.

kul-p80-v2000.quick_english: O goddess, from removing darkness, it is called smṛti.

kul-p81-v2001.quick_english: It is called itihāsa because it removes all sufferings.

kul-p81-v2002.quick_english: Āgama is said, dear, because it declares mahātma-tattva.

kul-p81-v2003.quick_english: It is called śākta because of the presence of supreme śakti.

kul-p81-v2004.quick_english: It is called kaula because of connection with all kula.

kul-p81-v2005.quick_english: Tradition is declared thus because it is contemplated by ascetics.

kul-p81-v2006.quick_english: Sampradāya is declared thus because it causes fame and auspiciousness.

kul-p81-v2007.quick_english: Āmnāya is called thus because it is the cause of sacrifice and dharma.

kul-p81-v2008.quick_english: It is called śrauta because it is unbroken in śruti.

kul-p81-v2009.quick_english: Ācāra is praised thus because it pacifies rāga, dveṣa, and the rest.

kul-p81-v2010.quick_english: Good ones call it dīkṣā because it liberates from world bondage.

kul-p81-v2011.quick_english: Abhiṣeka is remembered thus because it generates trembling bliss and the rest.

kul-p81-v2012.quick_english: Upadeśa is remembered thus because it is the cause of śaktipāta.

kul-p81-v2013.quick_english: Mantra is called mantra because it protects from all fears.

kul-p81-v2014.quick_english: Devatā is well praised because it pacifies the three tāpas and similar afflictions.

kul-p81-v2015.quick_english: Nyāsa is called nyāsa because it protects all.

kul-p81-v2016.quick_english: Therefore mudrā is famous and is to be shown, O Kuleśvarī.

kul-p81-v2017.quick_english: Akṣamālikā is so called because it is mātṛkā essence and causes gain.

kul-p81-v2018.quick_english: Maṇḍala is well praised, O Deveśī, because it is lovely.

kul-p81-v2019.quick_english: Kalaśa is well praised because it pacifies great sins and similar faults.

kul-p81-v2020.quick_english: Yantra is declared yantra because it constantly protects.

kul-p81-v2021.quick_english: Āsana is said to be āsana, dear one, because it bestows nine siddhis.

kul-p81-v2022.quick_english: Madya is called madya because it frees from eight sufferings and similar afflictions.

kul-p81-v2023.quick_english: Madya is called madya, O Devī, because it generates my essence.

kul-p81-v2024.quick_english: Surā is well praised because it gives surā form.

kul-p81-v2025.quick_english: Because it causes the manifestation of tattva, it is called amṛta, dear one.

kul-p82-v2026.quick_english: The vessel is called the saving of the fallen, O goddess.

kul-p82-v2027.quick_english: The wise know that support indeed protects the supported.

kul-p82-v2028.quick_english: Meat is called dear to all the gods.

kul-p82-v2029.quick_english: Worship is declared from the giving of complete fruit, beloved.

kul-p82-v2030.quick_english: Worship is declared from delighting all the gods.

kul-p82-v2031.quick_english: Libation is declared from generating new bliss.

kul-p82-v2032.quick_english: Fragrance is called the giving of dharma knowledge.

kul-p82-v2033.quick_english: Fragrance is declared from subduing burning suffering.

kul-p82-v2034.quick_english: Unbroken rice are praised from making identity, O goddess.

kul-p82-v2035.quick_english: Flower is called the giving of abundant meaning.

kul-p82-v2036.quick_english: Incense is called the generation of supreme bliss.

kul-p82-v2037.quick_english: Lamp is called the illumination of supreme reality.

kul-p82-v2038.quick_english: Liberation is renowned as the lamp; thus it is said to be the sole means of the path to liberation.

kul-p82-v2039.quick_english: By offering the food-offering, satisfaction arises; the food-offering is so declared.

kul-p82-v2040.quick_english: By pacifying clinging sin, the offering is called bali.

kul-p82-v2041.quick_english: Because it causes the illumination of reality, the three realities are so declared.

kul-p82-v2042.quick_english: On the ground that it has auspicious duty as its root, caluka is declared, O beloved.

kul-p82-v2043.quick_english: By seeing the supreme reality, grace arises; thus it is declared.

kul-p82-v2044.quick_english: By purification, O supreme goddess, the drink is so called.

kul-p82-v2045.quick_english: Near-service performed by rite is worship; thus it is declared.

kul-p82-v2046.quick_english: The devotee performs that preliminary rite in advance, O beloved.

kul-p82-v2047.quick_english: Performance by rite is declared to be the offering; thus it is said.

kul-p82-v2048.quick_english: Sending to its own place is declared to be the soft seat, O beloved.

kul-p82-v2049.quick_english: On the seat, placement may occur; it is installation, O clan-leader goddess.

kul-p82-v2050.quick_english: Wherever immobility and restraint are declared, that is the seat.

kul-p83-v2051.quick_english: Covering is declared; veiling is spoken.

kul-p83-v2052.quick_english: Before the deity one should speak welcome and ask about welfare.

kul-p83-v2053.quick_english: The mouth rinse is said to be made with clove and cardamom.

kul-p83-v2054.quick_english: From giving invaluable fruit, arghya is thus called.

kul-p83-v2055.quick_english: Barley, fragrance, fruit, and flower proclaim the eight-limbed arghya.

kul-p83-v2056.quick_english: Body washing and bathing are done together with fragrant waters.

kul-p83-v2057.quick_english: Dear one, salutation is said to be eight-limbed prostration.

kul-p83-v2058.quick_english: He who protects that field is called the field protector.

kul-p83-v2059.quick_english: In brief, O great goddess, he who knows is the worshipper.

kul-p83-v2060.quick_english: This upper tradition is declared in brief and with detail.

kul-p83-v2061.quick_english: I have revealed it today; it must be diligently concealed.

kul-p83-v2062.quick_english: One should not read the liquor-excitement book, nor place a book on the ground.

kul-p83-v2063.quick_english: This should never be taught to one without a son, nor ever to a non-disciple.

kul-p83-v2064.quick_english: O goddess, whatever exists among the wise, that something has been spoken by me.

kul-p83-v2065.quick_english: Whoever reads the glory of the upper tradition in the presence of the sricakra.

kul-p83-v2066.quick_english: Vow, bathing, austerity, pilgrimage, and the like in sacrifice and deity worship.

kul-p83-v2067.quick_english: One should dwell in your presence; here no deliberation is to be done.

kul-p83-v2068.quick_english: Named the narration of desired action: the seventeenth chapter.

kul-p01-v1.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
kul-p01-v1.question: Who asked the supreme lord about supreme bliss?
kul-p01-v1.inference: Pārvatī's inquiry to the supreme lord frames the Kula discourse.
uncertainties: Internal sandhi of papraccheśaṃ is editor-resolved.

kul-p01-v2.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
kul-p01-v2.question: Who is described as all-knowing and refuge-loving?
premises: The verse names an all-knowing being.
Devotion makes that being easily won.
That being loves those who take refuge.
kul-p01-v2.inference: The verse praises a divine figure accessible through devotion and refuge.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical gender and number are inferred from context.

kul-p01-v3.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
kul-p01-v3.question: What kind of beings arise in terrible samsara?
premises: Samsara is called worthless and terrible.
Beings in it are stained by all sorrow.
kul-p01-v3.inference: The verse depicts samsara as a sorrow-stained condition.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the stained beings is not explicit.

kul-p01-v4.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
kul-p01-v4.question: Do beings born and dying in samsara have liberation?
premises: Beings are born and die in samsara.
For them, liberation does not exist.
kul-p01-v4.inference: The verse denies liberation to beings caught in birth and death.
uncertainties: The scope of "them" is inferred from context.

kul-p82-v2034.inference: Unbroken rice are praised from making identity.

kul-p82-v2035.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

kul-p82-v2035.inference: Flower is called from giving abundant meaning.

kul-p82-v2036.inference: Incense is called from generating supreme bliss.

kul-p82-v2037.inference: Lamp is called from illuminating supreme reality.

uncertainties: Scope of 'offering' not delimited beyond the instrumental form

premises: A cause is given in the fused compound form.

uncertainties: Which three realities are intended is not specified by this verse alone

uncertainties: The referent of caluka is not determinable from this verse alone

premises: Seeing of the supreme reality is the stated cause.

kul-p82-v2043.inference: By seeing the supreme reality, grace arises and is thus declared.
uncertainties: Mode of 'seeing' not specified by this verse alone

kul-p82-v2044.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

premises: The declaration is addressed to the supreme goddess.
The drink is designated by quotative attribution.
kul-p82-v2044.inference: By reason of purification, the drink is thus called, O supreme goddess.
uncertainties: Nature of the drink not specified by this verse alone

premises: Near-service performed by rite is named.

kul-p82-v2045.inference: Near-service performed by rite is declared to be worship.
uncertainties: Degree of equivalence not specified beyond declarative attribution

kul-p82-v2046.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

premises: An act is attributed to the devotee.
That act is anaphorically referred to.
It is named the preliminary rite, addressed to the beloved.
kul-p82-v2046.inference: For the devotee, that preliminary rite is what is performed in advance.
uncertainties: Content of the preliminary rite not specified by this verse alone

kul-p82-v2047.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

premises: Performance by rite is the stated manner.
An offering is the item named.
It is declared thus by attribution.
kul-p82-v2047.inference: Performance by rite is declared to be the offering.
uncertainties: Type of offering not specified by this verse alone

kul-p82-v2048.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)

The declaration is addressed to the beloved.

uncertainties: Ritual function of sending to its own place not specified by this verse alone

premises: The setting is on a seat.
That placement is named installation, addressed to the clan-leader goddess.
kul-p82-v2049.inference: On the seat, placement may occur; it is installation, O clan-leader goddess.
uncertainties: Object being placed not specified by this verse alone

kul-p82-v2050.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
kul-p82-v2050.question: Wherever is immobility and restraint declared?
kul-p82-v2050.inference: The seat is wherever immobility and restraint occur.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation to previous verse unclear.

kul-p83-v2051.inference: The verse names covering and veiling as declared and spoken.
uncertainties: none

kul-p83-v2052.question: What should be spoken before the deity?

kul-p83-v2053.question: What mouth rinse is said to be used?

kul-p01-v1.plain_english: Pārvatī asked the supreme lord, the supreme bliss.

kul-p01-v2.plain_english: All-knowing, easily won by devotion, and loving to those who take refuge.

kul-p01-v3.plain_english: In worthless and terrible samsara, beings are stained by all sorrow.

kul-p01-v4.plain_english: They are born and die, and for them liberation does not exist.
kul-p01-v4.sanskrit_cite: jāyante ca mirayante ca teṣāṃ mokṣo na vidyate

kul-p01-v5.plain_english: By what means, O lord of gods, is one liberated? Speak to me, O lord.
kul-p01-v5.sanskrit_cite: kenopāyena deveśa mucyate vada me prabho

kul-p01-v6.plain_english: By hearing it alone, a man is liberated from samsara.

kul-p01-v7.plain_english: All-knowing, all-doer, all-lord, stainless, and nondual.

kul-p01-v8.plain_english: Without qualities, existence-consciousness-bliss; its parts are called jiva.

kul-p01-v9.plain_english: Divided by womb and other conditions, by actions and organs and the like.

kul-p01-v10.plain_english: That body endowed with this and that birth, and life and enjoyment, are born of action.

kul-p01-v11.plain_english: The subtle linga body, imperishable after liberation, O dear one.

kul-p01-v12.plain_english: Celestial beings and liberated ones proceed in order.

kul-p01-v13.plain_english: A human, having become a knower by good deeds, obtains liberation if knowledge is present.

kul-p01-v14.plain_english: Truth-knowledge is not obtained without humanity.
kul-p01-v14.sanskrit_cite: na mānuṣyaṃ vinā yatra tattvajñānaṃ tu labhyate

kul-p01-v15.plain_english: A creature sometimes obtains human birth through accumulated merit.

kul-p01-v16.plain_english: Who is more sinful here than one who does not save himself?

kul-p01-v17.plain_english: One who does not know his own benefit becomes a self-killer.
kul-p01-v17.sanskrit_cite: na vettyātmahitaṃ yastu sa bhavet ātmaghātakaḥ

kul-p01-v18.plain_english: Therefore, having obtained the wealth of a body, one should accomplish meritorious actions.

kul-p01-v19.plain_english: One should strive in protection until truth is seen.

kul-p01-v20.plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious action does not make the body recur again and again.
kul-p01-v20.sanskrit_cite: punaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ karma na śarīraṃ punaḥ punaḥ

kul-p01-v21.plain_english: Even those afflicted by leprosy do not desire to abandon the body.

kul-p01-v22.plain_english: Knowledge for meditation yoga soon liberates him.

kul-p01-v23.plain_english: Who else will save the self as a benefactor?

kul-p01-v24.plain_english: Having gone to a place without medicine, what will a diseased person do?
kul-p01-v24.sanskrit_cite: gatvā nirauṣadhaṃ sthānaṃ vyādhisthaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati

kul-p01-v25.plain_english: As long as this body stands, practice truth so long.

kul-p02-v26.plain_english: Diseases kill like enemies; therefore one should practice the good.

kul-p02-v27.plain_english: As long as there is no impairment of the senses, one should practice the good.

kul-p02-v28.plain_english: A creature attached to pleasure and pain does not know what benefits itself.

kul-p02-v29.plain_english: The world, having drunk the wine of delusion, never fears.
kul-p02-v29.sanskrit_cite: loko mohasurāṃ pītvā na vibheti kadācana

kul-p02-v30.plain_english: Life is unsteady like lightning; whose world could have steadiness?

kul-p02-v31.plain_english: Childhood, disease, old age, and sufferings make even half of life fruitless.

kul-p02-v32.plain_english: Why is one not killed by killers in a place of fear?
kul-p02-v32.sanskrit_cite: viśvastavyo bhayasthāne ghātakaiḥ kiṃ na hanyate

kul-p02-v33.plain_english: How do the fearless stand in an impermanent, unpleasant world?

kul-p02-v34.plain_english: A wealth-knower brings harm and does not know his own death.
kul-p02-v34.sanskrit_cite: anarthaṃ cārthavijñānī svamṛtyuṃ yo na vetti ca

kul-p02-v35.plain_english: Even while reading, one does not know, deluded by your māyā.

kul-p02-v36.plain_english: In the grasp of death, disease, and old age, one understands nothing at all.

kul-p02-v37.plain_english: Like a broken raw pot in water, it is not thought to endure.

kul-p02-v38.plain_english: The binding of waves is not a support that fits in life.

kul-p02-v39.plain_english: Devi, when ocean water dries in the body, what tale remains?
kul-p02-v39.sanskrit_cite: śuṣyate sāgarajalaṃ śarīre devi kā kathā

kul-p02-v40.plain_english: Time, like a wolf, forcibly kills the mortal who chatters.
kul-p02-v40.sanskrit_cite: lapantamiti marttyaṃ hi hanti kālavṛko balāt

kul-p02-v41.plain_english: Thus death eats people who are endowed with effort, dear one.

kul-p02-v42.plain_english: Death does not wait, whether something is done or not done.
kul-p02-v42.sanskrit_cite: na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vā'sya na vā kṛtam

kul-p02-v43.plain_english: You know death as an enemy; why do you not see it coming?

kul-p02-v44.plain_english: Death eats the man cooked in the fire of passion and hatred.

kul-p02-v45.plain_english: Death harms all; thus this created world is mortal.

kul-p02-v46.plain_english: Since destruction pursues all, therefore one should practice the good.

kul-p02-v47.plain_english: From greed for another's wife and wealth, life-decay may occur for men.

kul-p02-v48.plain_english: Life-decay for men may arise from non-restraint of the senses.

kul-p02-v49.plain_english: Creatures go to death, which is seen as sleep.
kul-p02-v49.sanskrit_cite: maraṇaṃ yena nidrdaṣṭaṃ tena gacchanti jantavaḥ

kul-p02-v50.plain_english: Having obtained the supreme portion, one abandons the former body.

kul-p03-v51.plain_english: Thus attainment of another body is like one who has arrived from one house to another.

kul-p03-v52.plain_english: Elsewhere, O goddess, the ignorant ones go and come again and again.

kul-p03-v53.plain_english: The fruit of a tree whose root is watered is seen on its branches.

kul-p03-v54.plain_english: These are the fruits of the tree of self-offense for embodied beings.

kul-p03-v55.plain_english: From association even a knower necessarily wavers; what then of one with little knowledge?

kul-p03-v56.plain_english: He should associate with good people; indeed association with the good is medicine.
kul-p03-v56.sanskrit_cite: sadbhaḥ saha sa karttavyaḥ satāṃ saṅgo hi bheṣajam

kul-p03-v57.plain_english: Whose guide is not present, he is blind; how would he not be a pathless goer?
kul-p03-v57.sanskrit_cite: yasya nāsti naraḥ so'ndhaḥ kathaṃ na syādamārgagaḥ

kul-p03-v58.plain_english: So many sorrow-arrows enter his heart.

kul-p03-v59.plain_english: Woman, mother, father, son, and so on—by what cause is this connection?

kul-p03-v60.plain_english: Dear one, he who has performed renunciation is happy, not another.
kul-p03-v60.sanskrit_cite: tasya tyāgaḥ kṛto yena sa sukhī nāparaḥ priye

kul-p03-v61.plain_english: Dear one, one should avoid samsara, the abode of all sins.

kul-p03-v62.plain_english: O goddess, for minds attached to samsara, cutting without a weapon.

kul-p03-v63.plain_english: Therefore, abandoning samsara and being devoted to truth, one may be happy.
kul-p03-v63.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt santyajya saṃsāraṃ tattvaniṣṭhaḥ sukhī bhavet

kul-p03-v64.plain_english: One attached to woman, wealth, and the like is never liberated.

kul-p03-v65.plain_english: Like water in an unripe pot, they perish by limb only.

kul-p03-v66.plain_english: Alas, sense-object foods devour through body-seated sense thieves.

kul-p03-v67.plain_english: Thus the pleasure-greedy embodied one does not see yama's affliction.

kul-p03-v68.plain_english: Dear one, those devoted to filling the belly, being unwise, are hellish.

kul-p03-v69.plain_english: Dear one, the knower is called man, the knowledge-less beast.
kul-p03-v69.sanskrit_cite: jñānavān mānavaḥ prokto jñānahīnaḥ paśuḥ priye

kul-p03-v70.plain_english: Dear one, at night men are afflicted by love and sleep.

kul-p03-v71.plain_english: Alas, ignorance-deluded beings are born and die.
kul-p03-v71.sanskrit_cite: jāyante ca mirayante ca hā hantājñānamohitāḥ

kul-p03-v72.plain_english: O Parvati, fools do not know supreme truth and perish.
kul-p03-v72.sanskrit_cite: na jānanti paraṃ tattvaṃ mūḍhā naśyanti pārvati

kul-p03-v73.plain_english: Selves joined with ignorance wander as deceivers.

kul-p03-v74.plain_english: Deluded by mantra utterance, oblation, etc., and sacrifice extensions.

kul-p03-v75.plain_english: Fools deluded by your maya desire the hidden.

kul-p04-v76.plain_english: Goddess, is the great serpent dead from striking the anthill?

kul-p04-v77.plain_english: Knowers wander in the world and delude people too.

kul-p04-v78.plain_english: Abandon him who has fallen from both karma and brahman, as an outcaste.

kul-p04-v79.plain_english: Those who go like donkeys and others—are they yogins?

kul-p04-v80.plain_english: Are vulgar earth-and-ash wearers liberated indeed?
kul-p04-v80.sanskrit_cite: mṛdbhasmavāsino grāmyāḥ kiṃ te muktā bhavanti hi

kul-p04-v81.plain_english: Goddess, are those who chase gold and deer yogins?

kul-p04-v82.plain_english: Are those vow-keepers who are like frogs and fish true vow-keepers?

kul-p04-v83.plain_english: Goddess, are those who stand before people wise indeed?
kul-p04-v83.sanskrit_cite: janānāṃ purato devi vibudhāḥ kiṃ bhavanti hi

kul-p04-v84.plain_english: Are those who do not drink earth-water yogins?
kul-p04-v84.sanskrit_cite: na pibanti mahītoyaṃ yoginaste bhavanti kim

kul-p04-v85.plain_english: Are those who stand like boars and others yogins?

kul-p04-v86.plain_english: Mistress of kula, direct knowledge of truth is the cause of liberation.

kul-p04-v87.plain_english: Those bound by beast-bonds do not know ultimate truth.

kul-p04-v88.plain_english: How indeed do those grasped by time and death stand?

kul-p04-v89.plain_english: All of an imitator's speech is crow-speech.

kul-p04-v90.plain_english: Goddess, they recite day and night yet are turned away from supreme truth.

kul-p04-v91.plain_english: Distressed fools with agitated senses stand by thought.

kul-p04-v92.plain_english: They explain scripture's existence otherwise, and otherwise.

kul-p04-v93.plain_english: Some are slain by ego and deprived of instruction.

kul-p04-v94.plain_english: They do not know supreme truth, as a ladle does not know cooking juice.
kul-p04-v94.sanskrit_cite: na jānanti paraṃ tattvaṃ darvī pākarasaṃ yathā

kul-p04-v95.plain_english: They recite veda-scriptures; a knower of bhava is rare.

kul-p04-v96.plain_english: An evil-minded cowherd sees a goat in a thicket as in a well.
kul-p04-v96.sanskrit_cite: gopaḥ kakṣagataṃ chāgaṃ kūpe paśyati durmatiḥ

kul-p04-v97.plain_english: Darkness never turns back by lamp-news.

kul-p04-v98.plain_english: Goddess, for the wise, scripture is the cause of truth-knowledge.

kul-p04-v99.plain_english: Men famed by qualities such as true knowledge, giving, and heroism.

kul-p04-v100.plain_english: Thus those deluded by scripture stand far away; no doubt.
kul-p04-v100.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ ye śāstrasammūḍhāste dūrasthā na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p05-v101.plain_english: O goddess, one with a thousand-year lifespan does not indeed reach the end of the scriptures.

kul-p05-v102.plain_english: Therefore one should discern the essence, just as a swan separates milk from water.
kul-p05-v102.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt sāraṃ vijānīyāt kṣīraṃ haṃsa ivāmbhasaḥ

kul-p05-v103.plain_english: Like a person seeking grain discards the chaff, one should set aside all the scriptures.

kul-p05-v104.plain_english: O Goddess, for one who knows the truth, there is no further need of scripture.
kul-p05-v104.sanskrit_cite: tattvajñasya tathā devi na śāstreṇa prayojanam

kul-p05-v105.plain_english: O Goddess venerated by heroes, liberation comes only from knowledge, and in no other way.

kul-p05-v106.plain_english: In the same way, all the scriptures have knowledge alone as their cause.

kul-p05-v107.plain_english: From this toil of carrying a load of wood, there is one supreme, life-giving thing.

kul-p05-v108.plain_english: It is obtained through the mouth of the guru, and not otherwise, not even by millions of scriptures.

kul-p05-v109.plain_english: Sound-brahman consists of the scriptures, but the supreme brahman is born of discrimination.

kul-p05-v110.plain_english: They know my truth as free from both duality and non-duality.

kul-p05-v111.plain_english: A creature is bound by the thought 'this is mine' and released by the thought 'this is not mine'.

kul-p05-v112.plain_english: Other actions, other kinds of knowledge, and skill in crafts lead only to toil.

kul-p05-v113.plain_english: As long as there is restlessness of the senses, so long, whence is discourse on truth?

kul-p05-v114.plain_english: As long as the mind lacks steadiness, truth-discourse is impossible.

kul-p05-v115.plain_english: As long as guru compassion is absent, truth-discourse is absent.

kul-p05-v116.plain_english: As long as truth is not found, veda-scripture-agama discourse remains empty.

kul-p05-v117.plain_english: One may become devoted to truth, goddess, if one desires liberation of the self.

kul-p05-v118.plain_english: Burnt by the three afflictions, one should seek the shade of the liberation tree.

kul-p05-v119.plain_english: Without kula-dharma there is no release; this is truth, no doubt.

kul-p05-v120.plain_english: Easily, goddess, one is released from terrible samsara bondage.

kul-p05-v121.plain_english: In brief, kuleshani, what more do you desire to hear?

kul-p05-v122.plain_english: Establishment-discourse is named the first illumination.

kul-p05-v123.plain_english: Kula-dharma, god, has been hinted by you, not revealed.

kul-p05-v124.plain_english: Speak to me, supreme lord, if your compassion is in me.
kul-p05-v124.sanskrit_cite: vada me parameśāna yadi te'sti kṛpā mayi

kul-p05-v125.plain_english: By merely hearing it, one may become dear to the yoginis.

kul-p06-v126.plain_english: I speak to you from affection; listen with a one-pointed mind.

kul-p06-v127.plain_english: It is unspeakable in the ultimate sense, yet nevertheless I speak it to you.

kul-p06-v128.plain_english: It should be given to a devotee or disciple; otherwise there would be a fall.
kul-p06-v128.sanskrit_cite: deyaṃ bhaktāya śiṣyāya anyathā patanaṃ bhavet

kul-p06-v129.plain_english: Better than Vaiṣṇava is Śaiva; better than Śaiva is the dakṣiṇa best.

kul-p06-v130.plain_english: Better than siddhānta is Kaula; nothing is higher than Kaula indeed.
kul-p06-v130.sanskrit_cite: siddhāntāduttamaṃ kaulaṃ kaulāt parataraṃ na hi

kul-p06-v131.plain_english: O goddess, Kula, directly giving Śiva, has passed from ear to ear.

kul-p06-v132.plain_english: By me, knower of essence, O goddess, the Kula dharma has been extracted.

kul-p06-v133.plain_english: On one side is Kula dharma; there, beloved, Kaula is greater.

kul-p06-v134.plain_english: Thus also various dharmas have entered; indeed it is Kula.
kul-p06-v134.sanskrit_cite: tathaiva vividhā dharmāḥ praviṣṭāḥ kulameva hi

kul-p06-v135.plain_english: And all views, beloved, are indeed Kula, thus.
kul-p06-v135.sanskrit_cite: darśanāni ca sarvāṇi kula eva tathā priye

kul-p06-v136.plain_english: Then, by Kula dharma, another samaya would be equal.
kul-p06-v136.sanskrit_cite: tadā ca kuladharmeṇa samayo'nyaḥ samo bhavet

kul-p06-v137.plain_english: Thus also all samayas are not equal by Kula dharma.
kul-p06-v137.sanskrit_cite: tathaiva samayāḥ sarve kuladharmeṇa no samāḥ

kul-p06-v138.plain_english: Thus there is a great difference between kula and any other samaya.

kul-p06-v139.plain_english: Even so, the same dharma is never found through kula.

kul-p06-v140.plain_english: Bound by the noose of saṃsāra, he becomes beloved among those who abandon.

kul-p06-v141.plain_english: He obtains sin greater than brahmin-killing, without doubt.
kul-p06-v141.sanskrit_cite: brahmahatyādhikaṃ pāpaṃ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p06-v142.plain_english: Having gone to another island beyond heaven, one enjoys the jewel of liberation.

kul-p06-v143.plain_english: But kaulas obtain liberation immediately, without doubt.
kul-p06-v143.sanskrit_cite: mokṣaṃ labhante kaule tu sadya eva na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p06-v144.plain_english: There is no dharma equal to kaula; I swear to you, kula-nāyikā.

kul-p06-v145.plain_english: Kaula is the essence of enjoyment-yoga; therefore, beloved, it is greater than all.

kul-p06-v146.plain_english: And saṃsāra becomes liberation in kula dharma, O kula-lady.

kul-p06-v147.plain_english: Devoted to kula dharma, O goddess, among humans what need is there to say more?
kul-p06-v147.sanskrit_cite: kuladharmaparā devi mānuṣeṣu ca kā kathā

kul-p06-v148.plain_english: One should indeed know kula, if one desires siddhi of the self.

kul-p06-v149.plain_english: Instruction and the like without kula are like a conviction risen from a dream.

kul-p06-v150.plain_english: That indeed the creature obtains; instruction is useless.

kul-p07-v151.plain_english: For one whose mind is purified as if by mantra, the knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p07-v152.plain_english: And those who are established in the dharma of Kula are all non-returning.

kul-p07-v153.plain_english: O Goddess, the knowledge of Kula shines forth in people whose sins have been exhausted.

kul-p07-v154.plain_english: And through devotion to the deity and the guru, the knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p07-v155.plain_english: For one who is extremely devoted to the secret, the knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p07-v156.plain_english: For whoever has firm devotion, the knowledge of Kula shines forth.

kul-p07-v157.plain_english: Kula knowledge is obtained through observances that fulfill the guru's command.

kul-p07-v158.plain_english: Therefore, after examining the recipient, the Kula knowledge spoken by me should be taught.

kul-p07-v159.plain_english: Whoever breaks the command would incur the curse of the deity.

kul-p07-v160.plain_english: That guru and that disciple would become bound beings before the yoginis.
kul-p07-v160.sanskrit_cite: sa guruścāpi śiṣyaśca yoginīnāṃ bhavet paśuḥ

kul-p07-v161.plain_english: Both of them would directly attain the meeting of the yoginis and heroes.

kul-p07-v162.plain_english: Having known this Kula dharma, one is liberated; there is no doubt about this.

kul-p07-v163.plain_english: Therefore, without delay and without doubt, one should take refuge in the Kaula way.

kul-p07-v164.plain_english: O Parvati, abandoning milk-rice in one's own house to beg and wander is foolish.

kul-p07-v165.plain_english: Having abandoned a jewel in hand, one foolishly desires distant glass.

kul-p07-v166.plain_english: He abandons a heap of grain and wishes to grasp a heap of dust.

kul-p07-v167.plain_english: Thirst-afflicted, he runs toward a mirage as if from a pond.

kul-p07-v168.plain_english: O Kula leader, other systems are not such as glorious Kaula.

kul-p07-v169.plain_english: He wishes to cross the boundless far shore with his hands.

kul-p07-v170.plain_english: With dream-gained wealth indeed, he would become wealthy then.

kul-p07-v171.plain_english: So from other systems, enjoyment and liberation shine forth.

kul-p07-v172.plain_english: O Kula ladies, one steadfast in Kula is the vessel of enjoyment and liberation.

kul-p07-v173.plain_english: He too attains a good goal; how much more his devoted follower.

kul-p07-v174.plain_english: Honored, he honors quickly; therefore do not abandon him.

kul-p07-v175.plain_english: Let people laugh at me; let kings punish me.
kul-p07-v175.sanskrit_cite: janā hasantu māṃ dṛṣṭvā rājāno daṇḍayantu vā

kul-p08-v176.plain_english: I will not abandon your dharma by mind, speech, body, or action.

kul-p08-v177.plain_english: He is worshipped by the gods there and becomes Shiva.
kul-p08-v177.sanskrit_cite: sa tu sampūjyate devairamutra sa śivo bhavet

kul-p08-v178.plain_english: Whoever worships you with devotion obtains a good destination.

kul-p08-v179.plain_english: Whether death comes today or at the end of an age, one must never abandon kula.
kul-p08-v179.sanskrit_cite: mṛtiradya yugānte vā kulaṃ naiva parityajet

kul-p08-v180.plain_english: One must not abandon kula-dharma from desire or even from fear.

kul-p08-v181.plain_english: One suffers from the very moment of birth, by the bhuta enemy and the enemy within.

kul-p08-v182.plain_english: Like bubbles in water, those who are averse to kaula are fleeting.
kul-p08-v182.sanskrit_cite: budbudā iva toyeṣu ye kaulavimukhā hi te

kul-p08-v183.plain_english: He truly lives whose mind is established in kula-dharma.
kul-p08-v183.sanskrit_cite: sa jīvati mano yasya kuladharme vyavasthitam

kul-p08-v184.plain_english: Though he breathes like a blacksmith's bellows, he does not truly live.

kul-p08-v185.plain_english: O Kuleshvari, the life of one ignorant of kula-command is like that of a beast.

kul-p08-v186.plain_english: Whether a vow-holder or not, a person averse to kaula is disqualified.

kul-p08-v187.plain_english: O goddess, devoted to kula-dharma; the rest are gate-donkeys.

kul-p08-v188.plain_english: The other is the supreme truth, covered by bone and skin.

kul-p08-v189.plain_english: Even a dog-cooker who knows kula surpasses a brahmin.

kul-p08-v190.plain_english: O goddess, this one devoted to kula worship is kaula, not others.
kul-p08-v190.sanskrit_cite: kulapūjārato devi so'yaṃ kaulo na cetareḥ

kul-p08-v191.plain_english: Shame on him; his life is like a crow's.
kul-p08-v191.sanskrit_cite: na pūjayati dhik tasya tat kākasyeva jīvitam

kul-p08-v192.plain_english: O goddess, for those by fortune, kula-knowledge shines.

kul-p08-v193.plain_english: For those in whose mind arises the kula-knowledge spoken by me.

kul-p08-v194.plain_english: All sacrifice practice is entry into kula dharma.

kul-p08-v195.plain_english: They never again enter the mother's womb.

kul-p08-v196.plain_english: O Kuleshani, kula-knowledge has no need of other dharmas.

kul-p08-v197.plain_english: I give supreme knowledge at the end time; there is no doubt.
kul-p08-v197.sanskrit_cite: dadāmi paramaṃ jñānaṃ cāntakāle na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p08-v198.plain_english: Kula gives all fruits easily; alas, who abandons it?

kul-p08-v199.plain_english: Even one knowing veda, shastra, and agama is ignorant without kula knowledge.

kul-p08-v200.plain_english: Only cakora birds know the beauty of the moon-rays; no others do.
kul-p08-v200.sanskrit_cite: cakorā eva jānanti nānye candragatāṃ rucim

kul-p09-v201.plain_english: Small rivers swell by moonlight; what of the ocean?
kul-p09-v201.sanskrit_cite: svalpā nadyo vivarddhante jyotsnayā kiṃ samudravat

kul-p09-v202.plain_english: Bees greedy for other flowers are servants of mandāra fragrance.

kul-p09-v203.plain_english: Śiva holds a lotus on his head; Rāhu's descendant swallows it—alas.

kul-p09-v204.plain_english: A crane drinks milk mixed with water; what does it know like a swan?

kul-p09-v205.plain_english: Therefore kaula is supreme over all; how can it be common to all?

kul-p09-v206.plain_english: Whoever makes a difference among them cuts my limb.
kul-p09-v206.sanskrit_cite: teṣu bhedantu yaḥ kuryānmamāṅgaṃ cchedayettu saḥ

kul-p09-v207.plain_english: Therefore know, beloved, that scripture is veda-natured and kaula-natured.

kul-p09-v208.plain_english: In this kula, beloved, the deity gives bliss and liberation to men.

kul-p09-v209.plain_english: Kula attains authority because it gives direct fruit.

kul-p09-v210.plain_english: By the power of perception, all doubters of it are slain.

kul-p09-v211.plain_english: Or that direct fruit-giving itself is the best vision.

kul-p09-v212.plain_english: Thus thinking, great goddess, I have investigated kaula.
kul-p09-v212.sanskrit_cite: iti matvā maheśāni mayā kaulaṃ vigahītam

kul-p09-v213.plain_english: The Kula way is reviled by ignorant bound beings who do not recognize it.

kul-p09-v214.plain_english: For him, neither the guru's compassion nor knowledge of Kula arises.

kul-p09-v215.plain_english: Thus, deluded by me, they do not know your Kula.
kul-p09-v215.sanskrit_cite: tathā kulaṃ na jānanti tava mayāvimohitāḥ

kul-p09-v216.plain_english: And people always pursue things whose fruits are nothing but vain effort.

kul-p09-v217.plain_english: Alas, alas, fools revile your vision, which is dear to me.
kul-p09-v217.sanskrit_cite: mūḍhā nindanti hā hanta matpriyaṃ tava darśanam

kul-p09-v218.plain_english: Those who are vainly proud of their knowledge do not know the Kula way.

kul-p09-v219.plain_english: Indeed, taking another form, it is for the delusion of the wicked.

kul-p09-v220.plain_english: And for them there is no progress, even in hundreds of crores of ages.

kul-p09-v221.plain_english: Even when restrained, a meritorious person still resorts to Kula alone.

kul-p09-v222.plain_english: Sages, lords of yogis, and others have attained the highest supreme accomplishment.

kul-p09-v223.plain_english: Those who truly serve the Kaula way are great and exceedingly rare.
kul-p09-v223.sanskrit_cite: ye kaulameva sevante te mahānto'ti durlabhāḥ

kul-p09-v224.plain_english: O great Goddess, this expert in the truth of Kula is rare.

kul-p09-v225.plain_english: The great do not serve the divine medicine that destroys great disease.

kul-p10-v226.plain_english: In the same way, they engage in worldly activity brought about by birth and death.

kul-p10-v227.plain_english: They do not resort to the Kula dharma, which liberates from the bondage of worldly existence.

kul-p10-v228.plain_english: O Lady of Kula, out of delusion humans affectionately beg from you.

kul-p10-v229.plain_english: In the same way, they turn to the scriptures of bound beings, which yield the fruits of bondage through action.

kul-p10-v230.plain_english: They do not ask about the Kula dharma, which grants the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

kul-p10-v231.plain_english: They mistake what is made of sugar for gravel, and a jewel for glass.

kul-p10-v232.plain_english: Likewise, deprived of your grace, they do not recognize the Kaula way.

kul-p10-v233.plain_english: O Lady of the gods, what then of ignorance—can it not delude even the immortals?

kul-p10-v234.plain_english: Thus indeed, this conduct is to be recited and practiced, and the supreme state is to be attained.

kul-p10-v235.plain_english: Only your devotees know that which grants enjoyment and liberation, not others.

kul-p10-v236.plain_english: Having been deluded before, they themselves delude all people.

kul-p10-v237.plain_english: What kind of master would he be? The servants would be of the same kind.

kul-p10-v238.plain_english: Those lacking traditional transmission imagine the matter through their own intellect.

kul-p10-v239.plain_english: Let all foolish wine-drinkers not imagine that they attain perfection.

kul-p10-v240.plain_english: In the world, those who eat once a month indeed become possessors of merit.
kul-p10-v240.sanskrit_cite: loke māsāśinaḥ sarve puṇyabhājo bhavanti hi

kul-p10-v241.plain_english: All beings in the world would be liberated merely from association with women.
kul-p10-v241.sanskrit_cite: sarve'pi jantavo loke muktāḥ syuḥ strīniṣevanāt

kul-p10-v242.plain_english: Those without conduct here are condemned, but not the others.

kul-p10-v243.plain_english: O goddess, foolish ones who think themselves learned wander thus.

kul-p10-v244.plain_english: Surely, like holding a serpent, Kula conduct is impossible.

kul-p10-v245.plain_english: That great sin is to be known as determined in the Vedas and other texts.

kul-p10-v246.plain_english: Wine, meat, and animals bring great fruit for Kaulas.

kul-p10-v247.plain_english: The twelfth, great wine, is the best of the best among all.

kul-p10-v248.plain_english: Therefore Brahmin, Kshatriya, and Vaishya should not drink liquor.

kul-p10-v249.plain_english: By merely smelling that, one should perform three breath controls.

kul-p10-v250.plain_english: Above the navel, the rule for touching wine is three nights.

kul-p12-v276.plain_english: Mantras born from each tradition give both enjoyment and liberation.

kul-p12-v277.plain_english: I alone spoke them, but from desire for the world's grace.

kul-p12-v278.plain_english: Those born from portions of us two are designated, O pure-smiling one.

kul-p12-v279.plain_english: By my grace, someone among millions of humans knows.

kul-p12-v280.plain_english: What more? A knower of the four traditions becomes directly śiva.

kul-p12-v281.plain_english: Therefore one should know that alone, if one desires perfection of self.

kul-p12-v282.plain_english: Upward tradition leads upward and downward-standing, and is thus called.

kul-p12-v283.plain_english: Because it is served only by the upward world, it is remembered as upward tradition.

kul-p12-v284.plain_english: Upward tradition, surpassing all traditions in fruit, is beyond beyond.

kul-p12-v285.plain_english: Among all traditions, upward tradition is so in śiva.

kul-p12-v286.plain_english: As Kāśī is among shrines, so the golden river is among rivers.
kul-p12-v286.sanskrit_cite: tīrthānāntu yathā kāśī svarnadī saritāṃ yathā

kul-p12-v287.plain_english: As horse-sacrifice is among rites, so a gem is among stones.

kul-p12-v288.plain_english: As the cow among four-footed beings, as the swan among birds, so the upward tradition is superior among all dharmas.

kul-p12-v289.plain_english: As the king among humans, as the head among limbs, so the upward tradition is supreme.

kul-p12-v290.plain_english: So indeed, dear one, the upward tradition is superior among all dharmas.

kul-p12-v291.plain_english: Know the upward tradition, hero-honored one; not otherwise.

kul-p12-v292.plain_english: Among them, in lakhs, someone declares the upward tradition.
kul-p12-v292.sanskrit_cite: teṣāṃ lakṣeṣu yaḥ kaścidūrdhvāmnāyaṃ pravetti ca

kul-p12-v293.plain_english: Not by sacrifices, not by austerities, nor by millions of shrine-vows.

kul-p12-v294.plain_english: The upward tradition is known through the glorious guru's mouth.

kul-p12-v295.plain_english: Therefore, goddess of gods, know the upward tradition, Kuleśvarī.

kul-p12-v296.plain_english: One obtains the desired perfection; truth, truth, best-faced one.
kul-p12-v296.sanskrit_cite: labhate kāṅkṣatāṃ siddhiṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane

kul-p12-v297.plain_english: By the scripture path that man is living-liberated; no doubt.
kul-p12-v297.sanskrit_cite: śāstramārgeṇa sa naro jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p12-v298.plain_english: He is worshipful, he is praised, he is to be seen, he is sāttvika.
kul-p12-v298.sanskrit_cite: sa sevyaḥ sa ca saṃstutyaḥ sa draṣṭavyaḥ sa sāttvikaḥ

kul-p12-v299.plain_english: He is skilled in all knowledge of veda, āgama, śāstra, and so on.

kul-p12-v300.plain_english: He is a sacrificer, he is pure-souled, he is a reciter, and he is a practitioner.
kul-p12-v300.sanskrit_cite: sa yajvā sa ca pūtātmā sa jāpī sa ca sādhakaḥ

kul-p13-v301.plain_english: O beloved, he is a meritorious soul, he is all-knowing, he is liberated, he is Shiva himself.
kul-p13-v301.sanskrit_cite: sa puṇyātmā sa sarvajñaḥ sa muktaḥ sa śivaḥ priye

kul-p13-v302.plain_english: All those born in his lineage are meritorious, and his friends and relatives are purified.

kul-p13-v303.plain_english: And conversation with him yields a fruit greater than that of the royal sacrifice.

kul-p13-v304.plain_english: There is freedom from disease, abundant food, good rain, and absence of calamity.

kul-p13-v305.plain_english: O goddess, dissolution is western, and grace is northern.

kul-p13-v306.plain_english: The western is the discipline of action, and likewise the northern is the discipline of knowledge.

kul-p13-v307.plain_english: The signs of the southern transmission are declared to be twenty-five.

kul-p13-v308.plain_english: They know thirty-six signs in the glorious northern transmission.

kul-p13-v309.plain_english: Because of being directly of Shiva's nature, no action exists at all.

kul-p13-v310.plain_english: And out of affection for me, you know this truth, O beautiful-faced one.

kul-p13-v311.plain_english: O lady of Kula, the greatness of the mantra is being spoken in brief.

kul-p13-v312.plain_english: So I tell you out of affection; listen, O you who are dear to me as life.

kul-p13-v313.plain_english: He who knows our supreme form is himself shiva.
kul-p13-v313.sanskrit_cite: āvayoḥ paramākāraṃ yo vetti sa svayaṃ śivaḥ

kul-p13-v314.plain_english: This mantra exists, beloved, in the form of exhalation and inhalation.

kul-p13-v315.plain_english: Thus, beloved, the world is without the supreme grace mantra.

kul-p13-v316.plain_english: In reality, goddess, it is undivided, like wind in a fan.

kul-p13-v317.plain_english: Moonlight is in the moon, fire in wood, fragrance in flower, and fluid in water.
kul-p13-v317.sanskrit_cite: candre jyotsnā'nalaḥ kāṣṭhe puṣpe gandhe jale dravaḥ

kul-p13-v318.plain_english: Sweetness is in sugar, and coolness is in camphor.

kul-p13-v319.plain_english: This world also stands thus in the supreme grace mantra.

kul-p13-v320.plain_english: The universe also stands thus in this supreme grace mantra.

kul-p13-v321.plain_english: As sweetness does not arise for the eater without salt.
kul-p13-v321.sanskrit_cite: lavaṇena vinā svādu yathā bhokturna jāyate

kul-p13-v322.plain_english: Those devoid of power do not give fruit to the mantra.
kul-p13-v322.sanskrit_cite: te phalaṃ na prayacchanti mantraṃ śaktivivajītāḥ

kul-p13-v323.plain_english: The glorious prasada supreme mantra should be carefully hidden.
