kul-p36-v900.sanskrit_cite: pṛcchati svapatiṃ mugdhā kastvaṃ kāham ime ca ke

kul-p37-v901.plain_english: Ah, is this a garden? What is this, a house? Or is it a courtyard?
kul-p37-v901.sanskrit_cite: udyānaṃ kimidaṃ hanta gṛhaṃ kiṃ prāṅgaṇaṃ kimu

kul-p37-v902.plain_english: Having placed a relish in their own mouths, they place it into the mouths of their beloveds.

kul-p37-v903.plain_english: Holding wine vessels on their heads, the yogins dance.

kul-p37-v904.plain_english: The Kula powers dance with stumbling steps.

kul-p37-v905.plain_english: And the yoginis, overcome by intoxication, fall upon the men.

kul-p37-v906.plain_english: O leader of Kula, they perform various acts of conduct such as these.

kul-p37-v907.plain_english: Then indeed the foremost yogins attain the state of divinity.

kul-p37-v908.plain_english: O leader of Kula, the yoginis destroy that doubt without any uncertainty.

kul-p37-v909.plain_english: One should never reveal outside the account of what takes place in this circle.

kul-p37-v910.plain_english: One should honor them with devotion, and one should also conceal them with careful effort.

kul-p37-v911.plain_english: He who rejoices and salutes with devotion attains the state of the yogini.
kul-p37-v911.sanskrit_cite: modate vandate bhaktyā sa gacchet yoginīpadam

kul-p37-v912.plain_english: He obtains the fruit of millions of vows, pilgrimages, austerities, gifts, and sacrifices.

kul-p37-v913.plain_english: In the circle, the delight named unmana is for the hero-equal.

kul-p37-v914.plain_english: O kula heroines, the two desiring supreme brahma inquiry.

kul-p37-v915.plain_english: In this and that, equilibrium becomes equal in that delight.

kul-p37-v916.plain_english: Indeed, fainting proximity is known as supreme for root liberation.

kul-p37-v917.plain_english: This śāmbhavī seal is indeed hidden in all tantras.
kul-p37-v917.sanskrit_cite: eṣā tu śāmbhavī mudrā sarvatantreṣu gopitā

kul-p37-v918.plain_english: Heroes delighted by this are indeed śivas; there is no doubt.
kul-p37-v918.sanskrit_cite: anayollāsino vīrāḥ śivā eva na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p37-v919.plain_english: Then that supreme bliss cannot be spoken.
kul-p37-v919.sanskrit_cite: tadā yatparamaṃ saukhyamiti vaktuṃ na śakyate

kul-p37-v920.plain_english: That brahma meditation is seen by horripilation and the like, and is called so.

kul-p37-v921.plain_english: I am not indeed able to tell it, being awakened and absorbed in that.

kul-p37-v922.plain_english: Even when that vanishes for a moment, those of lost radiance grieve.

kul-p37-v923.plain_english: Eight states, trembling and the like, arise here; there is no doubt.

kul-p37-v924.plain_english: Having obtained the threshold state, they serve the temple long.
kul-p37-v924.sanskrit_cite: pratīhāri padaṃ prāptāḥ sevante mandiraṃ ciram

kul-p37-v925.plain_english: Those qualities are gathered by truth-knowledge in the knower of Kula truth.

kul-p38-v926.plain_english: The dream is called the waking-end state when the mind is stilled.

kul-p38-v927.plain_english: He who knows the seven delights is liberated and is a kaulika.
kul-p38-v927.sanskrit_cite: saptollāsañca yo vetti sa muktaḥ sa ca kaulikaḥ

kul-p38-v928.plain_english: When the bhairavi circle has ceased, all letters are separate.
kul-p38-v928.sanskrit_cite: nivṛtte bhairavīcakre sarve varṇāḥ pṛthak pṛthak

kul-p38-v929.plain_english: In this circle there is no difference; all are remembered as equal to Shiva.

kul-p38-v930.plain_english: All humans attain oneness in the middle of the shri circle.

kul-p38-v931.plain_english: Thus in the middle of the shri circle no birth difference is found.
kul-p38-v931.sanskrit_cite: tathā śrīcakramadhye tu jātibhedo na vidyate

kul-p38-v932.plain_english: Likewise in the circle middle the deities are all humans.

kul-p38-v933.plain_english: Thus it is established in the veda: all indeed are brahman, it was said.
kul-p38-v933.sanskrit_cite: vede'pi sthitamevaṃ hi sarve hi brahma cābravīt

kul-p38-v934.plain_english: All men are my form, women are your form, dear one.
kul-p38-v934.sanskrit_cite: madrūpā puruṣāḥ sarve tvadrūpāḥ pramadāḥ priye

kul-p38-v935.plain_english: The yoginis devour him; I swear to you, kula leader.

kul-p38-v936.plain_english: Or, having made union, one gradually seats them together.

kul-p38-v937.plain_english: With shiva-shakti mind, one worships all in the middle of the circle.

kul-p38-v938.plain_english: As the pair of speech creators, so is the hero with shakti.

kul-p38-v939.plain_english: I am not satisfied, best-exalted one, without bhaga-linga nectar.

kul-p38-v940.plain_english: Linga-mark and bhaga-mark are therefore shakti-shiva nature.

kul-p38-v941.plain_english: That twilight is the samadhi prescribed for kula-steadfast ones.
kul-p38-v941.sanskrit_cite: sā sandhyā kulaniṣṭhānāṃ samādhiḥ sa vidhīyate

kul-p38-v942.plain_english: Immediately approach a woman purified by rite, by prescription.

kul-p38-v943.plain_english: In brief, kula-lady, what more do you wish to hear?

kul-p38-v944.plain_english: The discourse on difference of three principles and drinking is named the eighth delight.

kul-p38-v945.plain_english: Tell me, ocean of compassion, the fruit of kula devotion and worship.

kul-p38-v946.plain_english: Through mere hearing of it, yoga shines directly.

kul-p38-v947.plain_english: With form is gross, they say; formless is subtle.

kul-p38-v948.plain_english: In the gross, mind becomes motionless; in the subtle, also motionless.
kul-p38-v948.sanskrit_cite: sthūle'pi niścalaṃ ceto bhavet sūkṣme'pi niścalam

kul-p38-v950.plain_english: It shines by itself, then illuminating others without means.

kul-p40-v976.plain_english: As sunrise dispels darkness, he destroys all sin.
kul-p40-v976.sanskrit_cite: sa sarvaṃ pātakaṃ hanyāttamaḥ sūryodayo yathā

kul-p40-v977.plain_english: The truth-knower obtains that fruit million-fold.

kul-p40-v978.plain_english: Japa-praise is lowest; homa-worship is lowest of the low.

kul-p40-v979.plain_english: Scripture-thought is lowest; world-thought is lowest of the low.

kul-p40-v980.plain_english: Meditation equals a million japa; dissolution equals a million meditation.

kul-p40-v981.plain_english: Supreme worship is not inquiry; indeed its fruit is beyond satisfaction.
kul-p40-v981.sanskrit_cite: nānusandhāt parā pūjā na hi tṛpteḥ paraṃ phalam

kul-p40-v982.plain_english: Thoughtless meditation is supreme; desireless fruit is supreme.

kul-p40-v983.plain_english: The yogi always performs worship without offerings.

kul-p40-v984.plain_english: Immersed in his own nature, that yogi is supreme truth-knower.

kul-p40-v985.plain_english: He abandons the garland of ignorance and worships with I-am-attitude.

kul-p40-v986.plain_english: Bond-bound is called soul; bond-free is Sadashiva.

kul-p40-v987.plain_english: Karma-bound is called soul; karma-free is Sadashiva.

kul-p40-v988.plain_english: The unawakened see the divine in images, but those who know the self see it everywhere.

kul-p40-v989.plain_english: That lord of yogis abides in equality, free from both joy and sorrow.

kul-p40-v990.plain_english: The yogi who knows the supreme truth abides in the body like a sojourner.

kul-p40-v991.plain_english: That yogi, the knower of the supreme truth, is immersed in his own true nature.

kul-p40-v992.plain_english: O Lady of Kula, so too the yogi who knows the truth dwells.
kul-p40-v992.sanskrit_cite: nivasanti kuleśāni tathā yogī ca tattvavit

kul-p40-v993.plain_english: He who abides thus is indeed the lord of yogis: he sees the self in the self.

kul-p40-v994.plain_english: For the wise, that itself is liberation; but for the unwise, it is sin.

kul-p40-v995.plain_english: He who is always free from doubt is called a Kula yogi.

kul-p40-v996.plain_english: Contemplating the unity of 'I' and 'that' in these two, one should dwell happily.

kul-p40-v997.plain_english: He who performs expiation is to be rejected and is only a bound being; there is no doubt.
kul-p40-v997.sanskrit_cite: prāyaścittī sa varjyaśca paśureva na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p40-v998.plain_english: Without the smell of meat, Paśupati himself is directly a bound being.

kul-p40-v999.plain_english: The Kula path has been declared by the great-souled Bhairava.

kul-p40-v1000.plain_english: Even what is untrue may be true for the Kaulikas, O Kuleshvari.

kul-p41-v1001.plain_english: O Kuleśvarī, even what is inaccessible may become accessible for the Kaulikas.

kul-p41-v1002.plain_english: O Kuleśvarī, for the Kaulikas there is neither heaven nor hell.
kul-p41-v1002.sanskrit_cite: na svargo naiva narakaṃ kaulikānāṃ kuleśvari

kul-p41-v1003.plain_english: O Kulanāyikā, even when seemingly destroyed, the Kaulikas flourish.

kul-p41-v1004.plain_english: O Kuleśvarī, all people act as relatives toward the Kaulikas.

kul-p41-v1005.plain_english: O Kuleśvarī, for the Kaulikas, obstacles become helpers in accomplishment.

kul-p41-v1006.plain_english: O Kuleśvarī, for the Kaulikas, even unrighteous things become righteous.

kul-p41-v1007.plain_english: O Kuleśvarī, for the Kaulikas, associations with women become meritorious.

kul-p41-v1008.plain_english: They are always accomplished in their intentions; there should be no deliberation about this.

kul-p41-v1009.plain_english: O Kuleśvarī, wherever and in whatever stage of life the Kula yogi may dwell...

kul-p41-v1010.plain_english: Those whose true nature is unknown wander over this earth.

kul-p41-v1011.plain_english: One should dwell in the midst of the world like someone mad, mute, or dull.

kul-p41-v1012.plain_english: So too is the course of yogis, like that of the stars and planets.

kul-p41-v1013.plain_english: As movement is not seen, so the course of yogis is not seen.

kul-p41-v1015.plain_english: They speak nothing, and so the yogi acts.

kul-p41-v1017.plain_english: Seeing from afar, he goes; so the yogi acts.
kul-p41-v1017.sanskrit_cite: vilokya dūrato yāti tathā yogī pravarttate

kul-p41-v1018.plain_english: The yogi in various garb roams on earth.

kul-p41-v1019.plain_english: Blessing all people, he plays on earth.

kul-p41-v1020.plain_english: The yogi, having enjoyed all enjoyments, is not smeared by sins.

kul-p41-v1021.plain_english: As all bathed in a river, so the yogi is always pure.

kul-p41-v1022.plain_english: So water from a mleccha house, drawn by the yogi's hand, is pure.

kul-p41-v1023.plain_english: That alone is honorable for the wise who wish their own welfare.

kul-p41-v1024.plain_english: The direction in which the sun rises is indeed called east.
kul-p41-v1024.sanskrit_cite: yasyāmudeti sūryo hi pūrvāśā sā nigadyate

kul-p41-v1025.plain_english: The kula-yogi may choose where that path is, O Kuleshvari.

kul-p42-v1026.plain_english: Who is able to restrain the self-willed, peaceful wanderer?

kul-p42-v1027.plain_english: Likewise, the knower is not seen while playing with the sense-snakes.

kul-p42-v1028.plain_english: Those peaceful devotees devoted to kula-knowledge and to you are kaulikas.

kul-p42-v1029.plain_english: Indeed, the lords of the kaulikas are steady, not followers controlled by the senses.

kul-p42-v1030.plain_english: May bliss-tears fall, O goddess; the best kaulikas are declared.

kul-p42-v1031.plain_english: Thus those firm-minded ones are declared by you to be the best kaulikas.

kul-p42-v1032.plain_english: He who is devoted to kula worship is a kaulika, not another, beloved.
kul-p42-v1032.sanskrit_cite: kulārcanarataḥ sa syāt kauliko nāparaḥ priye

kul-p42-v1034.plain_english: Devotees of deity and guru become kaulikas through initiation.

kul-p42-v1035.plain_english: It is obtained only by the ripening of merit, not otherwise, beloved.

kul-p42-v1036.plain_english: Even an outcaste is purified by chance by the best of kula-dharma.

kul-p42-v1037.plain_english: Where there is a kula-knower, O goddess, I am there with you.

kul-p42-v1042.plain_english: His ancestors praise him: we shall go to the supreme goal.

kul-p42-v1049.plain_english: Therefore one desiring my dear should worship only your devotees.

kul-p42-v1050.plain_english: All the gods are dear to Kula; therefore one should worship the Kaulika.

kul-p43-v1051.plain_english: O Parvati, I am pleased properly by the kaulika chief.

kul-p43-v1056.plain_english: Like ashes is the offered oblation; so is a gift to a non-kaulika.

kul-p43-v1057.plain_english: That fruit is not described at all, especially on festive tithis with affection.

kul-p43-v1058.plain_english: Having worshipped with deity-buddhi, with sandal, flowers, rice, and so on.

kul-p43-v1059.plain_english: When they are pleased, I am pleased, and all deities would be pleased.

kul-p43-v1060.plain_english: O goddess, his merit is not counted for the intoxicated lord.

kul-p43-v1061.plain_english: The provision for the other world is honey drunk in the vira circle.

kul-p43-v1062.plain_english: Indeed, the kula substance is born, drunk by the kula yogi lord.

kul-p43-v1063.plain_english: That place too becomes purified; how much more those standing there.

kul-p43-v1064.plain_english: What then of merit enjoyed by many; it is not counted at all.

kul-p43-v1066.plain_english: So long, varna and ashrama conduct is to be done for liberation from action.

kul-p43-v1067.plain_english: Liberation would be by shiva through that; therefore perform action.

kul-p43-v1074.plain_english: Heretics, those who think themselves learned, go to hell, dear.

kul-p44-v1076.plain_english: Those in whose heart brahman is established are not stained by merit and sin.

kul-p44-v1078.plain_english: In brief, lady of kula, what more do you desire to hear?

kul-p44-v1079.plain_english: The narration of yoga establishment is named the ninth delight.

kul-p44-v1080.plain_english: Speak to me, god, supreme lord, the fruit of its worship.

kul-p44-v1081.plain_english: By mere hearing of it one is freed from all sins.

kul-p44-v1082.plain_english: Monthly worship is lowest, goddess; beyond a month one becomes a beast.

kul-p44-v1083.plain_english: If the beast again desires entry, initiate again.

kul-p44-v1092.plain_english: A kaulika not doing so through delusion may obtain a deity curse.

kul-p44-v1094.plain_english: One should please them with kula substances, kula worship first.

kul-p44-v1098.plain_english: That shri chakra is said; its group also is called that.

kul-p44-v1099.plain_english: The pure-minded practitioner should invite early with devotion.

kul-p44-v1100.plain_english: O goddess, the mantra-holder, having bathed and being pure-souled, should then perform sequential worship.

kul-p45-v1102.plain_english: One should satisfy her with banana, coconut, and other fruits.

kul-p45-v1103.plain_english: One should chant the mantra according to ability, increasing by one, or otherwise as prescribed.

kul-p45-v1104.plain_english: Then, regarding her as the deity, one should salute her and dismiss her.

kul-p45-v1105.plain_english: Thus on the tithi one should worship the maiden chosen on the previous day.

kul-p45-v1107.plain_english: One should worship them separately with names ending in the fourth case.

kul-p45-v1108.plain_english: One should worship with sandal paste, flowers, garments, and similar items according to one's means.

kul-p54-v1332.sanskrit_cite: na gṛhṇāti hi śiṣyaścettadā pāpaṃ gurorna hi

kul-p54-v1333.plain_english: Thus the teacher obtains the disciple's sin without doubt, dear one.

kul-p54-v1334.plain_english: Goddess, what more of the kula conduct rule do you wish to hear?

kul-p54-v1335.plain_english: The eleventh illumination is named kula conduct description.

kul-p54-v1336.plain_english: Lord of gods, tell me about conduct also, ocean of compassion.

kul-p54-v1337.plain_english: By merely hearing it, devotion arises quickly, lord of creatures.

kul-p54-v1338.plain_english: Thus knowledge is established in the footwear within the kula ocean.

kul-p54-v1339.plain_english: Remembering the sacred footwear is supreme beyond ten million great sacrifices.

kul-p54-v1340.plain_english: Remembering the sacred footwear is supreme beyond ten million god worships.

kul-p54-v1341.plain_english: Remembered, the footwear protects in great danger and great sin.

kul-p54-v1342.plain_english: Remembered, the footwear protects in bad conduct and bad mind.
kul-p54-v1342.sanskrit_cite: durācāre ca durbuddhau smṛtā rakṣati pādukā

kul-p54-v1343.plain_english: Whose tongue tip always holds the memory of the sacred footwear.

kul-p54-v1344.plain_english: He, free from all sin, obtains the supreme goal.

kul-p54-v1345.plain_english: He obtains dharma, wealth, and liberation without effort.

kul-p54-v1346.plain_english: Dear one, salute that direction with devotion daily.
kul-p54-v1346.sanskrit_cite: tasyāṃ diśi namaskuryāt bhaktyā pratidinaṃ priye

kul-p54-v1347.plain_english: No initiation is supreme beyond the shakta, and no merit equals kula worship.
kul-p54-v1347.sanskrit_cite: na hi śāktāt parā dīkṣā na puṇyaṃ kulapūjanāt

kul-p54-v1348.plain_english: The teacher's speech is the root of mantra, and the teacher's grace is the root of liberation.

kul-p54-v1349.plain_english: Therefore the teacher should be served with devotion for success.

kul-p54-v1350.plain_english: Until one comes to refuge in Śrīguru, who loves devotees.

kul-p55-v1351.plain_english: Until devotion to the true teacher arises, O goddess, there is no devotion among embodied beings.

kul-p55-v1352.plain_english: This supreme reality, the great sequence, is rooted in the grace of the teacher.

kul-p55-v1353.plain_english: Thus one should please the teacher with devotion, wealth, life-breaths, and effort.
kul-p55-v1353.sanskrit_cite: tathā bhaktyā dhanaiḥ prāṇairguruṃ yatnena toṣayet

kul-p55-v1354.plain_english: Then the disciple becomes liberated; thereafter there is no rebirth.

kul-p55-v1355.plain_english: When the teacher is pleased, the disciple's sins are immediately destroyed.
kul-p55-v1355.sanskrit_cite: gurau prasanne śiṣyasya sadyaḥ pāpakṣayo bhavet

kul-p55-v1356.plain_english: The devotee-loving lords fulfill all those things.

kul-p55-v1357.plain_english: When the teacher is pleased, the satisfied ones bestow favor; there is no doubt.
kul-p55-v1357.sanskrit_cite: kurvantyanugrahaṃ tuṣṭā gurau tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p55-v1358.plain_english: The disciple becomes free from action and is a vessel of enjoyment and liberation.

kul-p55-v1359.plain_english: O goddess, one should do pleasing things by mind, speech, body, and actions.

kul-p55-v1360.plain_english: When he is instructed, "You are liberated," he too goes to liberation, dear one.
kul-p55-v1360.sanskrit_cite: mukto'sīti samādiṣṭaḥ so'pi muktiṃ vrajet priye

kul-p55-v1361.plain_english: In the form of the teacher, he releases the bound soul from its bond.

kul-p55-v1362.plain_english: To him something is to be given, then received; he is indeed worshipful, and so am I.
kul-p55-v1362.sanskrit_cite: tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa tu pūjyo hyahaṃ tathā

kul-p55-v1363.plain_english: Even a barbarian lacking virtue is called a disciple if devoted.

kul-p55-v1364.plain_english: There all else perishes; ornament and world-pleasing remain.

kul-p55-v1365.plain_english: Even a dog-cooker may be worshipful; even a scholar is not an atheist.
kul-p55-v1365.sanskrit_cite: śvapaco'pi paraiḥ pūjyo vidvānapi na nāstikaḥ

kul-p55-v1366.plain_english: O goddess, whose devotion to the holy teacher is always steady.
kul-p55-v1366.sanskrit_cite: sarvārthaiḥ śrīgurau devi yasya bhaktiḥ sadā sthirā

kul-p55-v1367.plain_english: Thus one should remember by devotion; otherwise his power stays far away.
kul-p55-v1367.sanskrit_cite: iti bhaktyā smared yastu tasya sidviradūrataḥ

kul-p55-v1368.plain_english: His meanings are indeed told to you and shine forth, O lady of the family.
kul-p55-v1368.sanskrit_cite: tasya te kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante kuleśvari

kul-p55-v1369.plain_english: O great goddess, devotion should be done in one's own teacher.
kul-p55-v1369.sanskrit_cite: bhaktiryathā mahādevi tathā kāryā nije gurau

kul-p55-v1370.plain_english: One should think of the holy teacher, the teacher's wife, and the parents.

kul-p55-v1371.plain_english: Sacrifice is not so dear, O dear one, as gift, austerity, pilgrimage, and vow.

kul-p55-v1372.plain_english: Thus, thus his knowledge grows, O family leader.

kul-p55-v1373.plain_english: O goddess, selfless service is indeed devotion to the true teacher.

kul-p55-v1374.plain_english: O goddess, that fruit is obtained easily by service to the teacher.
kul-p55-v1374.sanskrit_cite: tat phalaṃ labhate devi sukhena gurusevayā

kul-p55-v1375.plain_english: Devotion is only in the guru, O goddess; there is no other path—thus says scripture.
kul-p55-v1375.sanskrit_cite: bhaktireva gurau devi nānyaḥ panthā iti śrutiḥ

kul-p56-v1376.plain_english: Devotion burns a heap of cotton like fire in a moment.

kul-p56-v1377.plain_english: By devotion clay wood and stone bear fruit that is not fruitless.

kul-p56-v1378.plain_english: In this kula path without illusion devotion alone is distinguished.

kul-p56-v1379.plain_english: What mantra does not succeed for devotees in their field?
kul-p56-v1379.sanskrit_cite: kinnu bhaktimatāṃ kṣetre mantraḥ keṣāṃ na sidhyati

kul-p56-v1380.plain_english: One who makes stone-thought in images goes to hell.

kul-p56-v1381.plain_english: Success never comes by mantras or by deity worship alone.

kul-p56-v1382.plain_english: Dear one, all their good deeds become sin.
kul-p56-v1382.sanskrit_cite: teṣāṃ hi sukṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pātakaṃ bhavati priye

kul-p56-v1383.plain_english: Especially by the guru, the shower of dharma and adharma is worshipful.

kul-p56-v1384.plain_english: When Shiva is angry the guru protects; when the guru is angry no one protects.
kul-p56-v1384.sanskrit_cite: śive ruṣṭe gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kaścana

kul-p56-v1385.plain_english: By harmful conduct, O goddess, a worm is born in feces.

kul-p56-v1386.plain_english: They obtain worm insect and moth states, no doubt.

kul-p56-v1387.plain_english: By abandoning the guru's mantra one goes to raurava hell.

kul-p56-v1388.plain_english: Abandoning one's own life, one should perform the guru's work.

kul-p56-v1389.plain_english: Whether struck by him or granted grace, one should remember it thus.

kul-p56-v1390.plain_english: Thinking 'that is the remainder,' one should experience it, O Kuleshvari.

kul-p56-v1391.plain_english: One should not make pilgrimage, nor bathe for self-purification.

kul-p56-v1392.plain_english: A disciple, having become one, should not do so with gurus in any way.
kul-p56-v1392.sanskrit_cite: na kuryād gurubhiḥ sārddhaṃ śiṣyo bhūtvā kathañcana

kul-p56-v1393.plain_english: Seeing from afar, one should not go or sit with them ever.
kul-p56-v1393.sanskrit_cite: vilokya dūrato gacchennāsīta saha taiḥ kvacit

kul-p56-v1394.plain_english: He goes to terrible hell; that worship becomes fruitless.
kul-p56-v1394.sanskrit_cite: sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sā pūjā niṣphalā bhavet

kul-p56-v1395.plain_english: By his command it is to be done; the guru is remembered as command-form.

kul-p56-v1396.plain_english: By the guru's command one should take; what is forbidden by that, one should avoid.

kul-p56-v1397.plain_english: If he says one has fallen from the vow, there is no doubt.
kul-p56-v1397.sanskrit_cite: yadi brūyāt sa samayāccyuta eva na saṃśayaḥ

kul-p56-v1398.plain_english: One should do benefit for all beings as for oneself, O Kuleshvari.

kul-p56-v1399.plain_english: By service and with mind, O Devi, the disciple should please the guru.
kul-p56-v1399.sanskrit_cite: śuśrūṣayā dhiyā devi śiṣyaḥ santoṣayed gurum

kul-p56-v1400.plain_english: He who is devoted to service of the guru, deva, and great souls.

kul-p57-v1401.plain_english: If she is accompanied by true devotion, she gives the fruits of all desires.

kul-p57-v1402.plain_english: All tasks are accomplished, dear one, by service to the guru.

kul-p57-v1403.plain_english: Whoever worships the guru as deity has merit that is not counted.
kul-p57-v1403.sanskrit_cite: gurudevārcako yastu tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate

kul-p57-v1404.plain_english: Whether the matter is small or great, merit is equal for rich and poor.

kul-p57-v1405.plain_english: The disciple does not obtain fruit, for devotion alone is the cause.
kul-p57-v1405.sanskrit_cite: śiṣyo na phalamāpnoti bhaktireva hi kāraṇam

kul-p57-v1406.plain_english: If desire necessarily exists, it should be experienced by that command.

kul-p57-v1407.plain_english: From greed and delusion, he is cooked in hell for twenty-one-fold suffering.
kul-p57-v1407.sanskrit_cite: lobhānmohāt sa pacyeta narake ca trisaptake

kul-p57-v1408.plain_english: He, having attained animal birth, is eaten by carnivores, dear one.

kul-p57-v1409.plain_english: For the fallen wretch, no penance exists.

kul-p57-v1410.plain_english: They call this guru-treachery; whoever does it is a sinner.

kul-p57-v1411.plain_english: But whoever acts without offering becomes a brahmin-killer.
kul-p57-v1411.sanskrit_cite: anivedya tu yaḥ kuryāt sa bhaved brahmaghātakaḥ

kul-p57-v1412.plain_english: By gurus he is to be expelled; he is punishable and killable by executioners.
kul-p57-v1412.sanskrit_cite: gurubhiḥ sa bahiṣkāryo daṇḍyo vadhyaḥ sa ghātakaiḥ

kul-p57-v1413.plain_english: Blaming the guru even unto death brings great calamity from the guru's displeasure.

kul-p57-v1414.plain_english: Even one in death's hand is not an offender to the guru.

kul-p57-v1415.plain_english: After hearing, that is the remedy: remember the guru's name.
kul-p57-v1415.sanskrit_cite: gurornāma smaret paścāt śravaṇe sā pratikriyā

kul-p57-v1416.plain_english: One should not blame his vows, veda, scripture, āgama, and the like.

kul-p57-v1417.plain_english: Doing the guru's command is duty; service and worship are of the guru.

kul-p57-v1418.plain_english: Abandoning betel, collyrium, and dress, one should enter slowly.

kul-p57-v1419.plain_english: Seeing the guru, one should salute; one should not desire for self-enjoyment.

kul-p57-v1420.plain_english: Urine, spitting, shaving, lying, and intercourse with women.

kul-p57-v1421.plain_english: Hair-loosening, turban, jacket, nudity, and so on.

kul-p57-v1422.plain_english: Limb-breaking, body-instrument, and so on, hand-clapping, and shaking.

kul-p57-v1423.plain_english: One should not do or act from delusion, lest one get a deity's curse.

kul-p57-v1424.plain_english: Face-looking, one should serve; and that which was said, one should perform.

kul-p57-v1425.plain_english: Whatever the guru says, that should be done without doubt, with bowed head.

kul-p58-v1426.plain_english: Whatever scripture has gone forth from the guru's mouth, all of that is called scripture.

kul-p58-v1427.plain_english: Even when accompanied by many servants and others, he should be greatly devoted.

kul-p58-v1428.plain_english: He should indeed carry out the guru's command with his inner self aligned to it.

kul-p58-v1429.plain_english: The disciple should always serve constantly in the presence of the guru.

kul-p58-v1430.plain_english: O goddess, he should stand on a ground seat and perform the guru's work.

kul-p58-v1431.plain_english: Having gone to the guru's side, one should be humble and cheerful-faced.

kul-p58-v1432.plain_english: If one acts against him, all fault becomes ten-million-fold.

kul-p58-v1433.plain_english: Whether harmful or beneficial, one would go to Raurava hell.
kul-p58-v1433.sanskrit_cite: ahitaṃ vā hitaṃ vāpi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet

kul-p58-v1434.plain_english: That sin is fully obtained from false speech before the guru.

kul-p58-v1435.plain_english: O beloved, one should not abandon the revered guru anywhere; the instructed one should go.
kul-p58-v1435.sanskrit_cite: śrīguruṃ na tyajet kvāpi tadādiṣṭo vrajet priye

kul-p58-v1436.plain_english: One should not go in front of him, nor stand when the guru rises.

kul-p58-v1437.plain_english: One should not do so in those places, nor sleep in the guru's presence.
kul-p58-v1437.sanskrit_cite: na teṣu kuryāt svacchāyāṃ na svaped gurusannidhau

kul-p58-v1438.plain_english: An uninstructed disciple should not act, nor act without first saluting.

kul-p58-v1439.plain_english: Two disciples should trust each other only by guru command, not by another's order.

kul-p58-v1440.plain_english: With devotion, having bowed, one should rise with joined palms, dear one.

kul-p58-v1441.plain_english: One should not sit on one seat with the guru or his equals.

kul-p58-v1442.plain_english: Juniors have their proper seats; others share the same seat.

kul-p58-v1443.plain_english: Having prostrated, one should circumambulate thrice.

kul-p58-v1444.plain_english: In another guru's presence, the disciple should bow to his own guru mentally.
kul-p58-v1444.sanskrit_cite: praguroḥ sannidhau śiṣyaḥ svaguruṃ manasā namet

kul-p58-v1445.plain_english: One should not bow to a metal or clay image as if it were god.

kul-p58-v1446.plain_english: Worshipful persons are saluted with joined palms; others with verbal salutation.

kul-p58-v1447.plain_english: One should bow to those more learned and established in their duty, O Kula leader.

kul-p58-v1448.plain_english: One should not bow to a wrongdoer, an ungrateful person, or one without āśrama.

kul-p58-v1449.plain_english: That food becomes impure, and the dead person is born as a pig.

kul-p58-v1450.plain_english: A disciple standing a krośa away should bow to the guru every day.

kul-p59-v1451.plain_english: Beginning at one yojana, the disciple may approach up to twelve yojanas.

kul-p59-v1452.plain_english: A disciple situated far away goes to the guru's presence with devotion.

kul-p59-v1453.plain_english: If the disciple has gone very far, he may go as he wishes.

kul-p59-v1454.plain_english: Let him offer fruits, flowers, garments, and the like according to his ability.

kul-p59-v1455.plain_english: The guru's power, his son, his elder brother, and the guru himself are remembered as guru.

kul-p59-v1456.plain_english: Let him salute one who resembles the guru as he would his own guru.

kul-p59-v1457.plain_english: Thus, O goddess, the guru's elder son is part of the elder quartet.

kul-p59-v1458.plain_english: The guru and the family tree are both to be venerated according to rite.

kul-p59-v1459.plain_english: One who does not rise and salute properly remains outside the class of fault-bearers.

kul-p59-v1460.plain_english: He who rises and salutes properly becomes the subject then.

kul-p59-v1461.plain_english: He, called a great beast, may incur a divine curse.

kul-p59-v1462.plain_english: He should be regarded like the guru and venerated by elders, O dear one.
kul-p59-v1462.sanskrit_cite: guruvat sa tu mantavyo jyeṣṭhairvandyo na ca priye

kul-p59-v1463.plain_english: In brief, mistress of the family, what more do you wish to hear?

kul-p59-v1464.plain_english: This is the discourse on the paduka, named the twelfth illumination.

kul-p59-v1465.plain_english: Lord, you should speak the characteristics of guru and disciple.

kul-p59-v1466.plain_english: Merely by hearing that, guru-nature arises.

kul-p59-v1467.plain_english: Another disciple, a heretic, a eunuch, and a proud scholar.

kul-p59-v1468.plain_english: Lame, blind, deaf, dirty, and disease-afflicted.

kul-p59-v1469.plain_english: Two-marked limb gesture and related gait, speech, and gaze.

kul-p59-v1470.plain_english: Inner-devotion-making, vile, and devoid of outer devotion.

kul-p59-v1471.plain_english: Lacking wealth, woman, and purity, and devoid of prohibition rules.

kul-p59-v1472.plain_english: Cat-and-mouse conduct, eager in seeking holes.

kul-p59-v1473.plain_english: Trust-destroyer, enemy of the lord, and sin-doer.

kul-p59-v1474.plain_english: Assassin, angry person, and false witness.

kul-p59-v1475.plain_english: untruthful, harshly attached, and speaking much of village matters and the like

kul-p60-v1476.plain_english: A vain abuser, fool, fickle person, and speech mocker.

kul-p60-v1477.plain_english: A speech-Brahma claimer, knowledge thief, and self-praiser.

kul-p60-v1478.plain_english: A talkative person, friend of bad people, and one despised by all worlds.

kul-p60-v1479.plain_english: One who claims own suffering, betrays the master, and deceives himself.

kul-p60-v1480.plain_english: One who does hatred, laughter, suffering, anger, and the like without cause.

kul-p60-v1481.plain_english: A lustful and very shameless person, and one indicating false bad conduct.

kul-p60-v1482.plain_english: One minded with jealousy, harshness, slander, stinginess, and anger.

kul-p60-v1483.plain_english: An unawakened mind, dull, foolish, worry-troubled, and rogue.

kul-p60-v1484.plain_english: Much eating, deceitful, deluding, and crooked, dear one.

kul-p60-v1485.plain_english: One who mocks the good speech of mother, father, guru, and wise persons.

kul-p60-v1486.plain_english: A guru should avoid a disciple endowed with such bad qualities.

kul-p60-v1487.plain_english: Endowed with samadhi, means, virtue, and character.

kul-p60-v1488.plain_english: A disciple with firm vows, good conduct, and endowed with faith and devotion.

kul-p60-v1489.plain_english: A deliberate doer, a hero, one who has conquered poverty of mind.

kul-p60-v1490.plain_english: Grateful, fearing sin, and approved by good and virtuous people.

kul-p60-v1491.plain_english: Endowed with trust and humility, transcending wealth, body, and the rest.

kul-p60-v1492.plain_english: Favorable, endowed with action, attentive, and discerning.

kul-p60-v1493.plain_english: Grasping household purpose when spoken once, clever, and of extensive wisdom.

kul-p60-v1494.plain_english: Sense-conquered, well content, wise, and celibate.

kul-p60-v1495.plain_english: Eager for guru meditation, praise, discourse, god worship, and salutation.

kul-p60-v1496.plain_english: Always standing near the guru and doing what satisfies the guru.

kul-p60-v1497.plain_english: Keeping the guru's commands and manifesting the guru's fame.

kul-p60-v1498.plain_english: Following the mind and acting as a servant, O kula leader.

kul-p60-v1499.plain_english: Desireless in guru wealth, desiring that grace.

kul-p60-v1500.plain_english: devoted to kula worship and the like, not despising kula wealth

kul-p61-v1501.plain_english: The guru should accept a disciple endowed with these characteristics.

kul-p61-v1502.plain_english: He is endowed with all characteristics and beautified in every limb.

kul-p61-v1503.plain_english: He enchants the world, appears god-like, and has a pleasant appearance.

kul-p61-v1504.plain_english: He knows gestures and forms, is wise, and shines in inference and refutation.

kul-p61-v1505.plain_english: He knows the accomplishment of commands across three times and is capable of restraint and grace.

kul-p61-v1506.plain_english: They are capable of controlling the senses and conquering the six enemies.

kul-p61-v1507.plain_english: The saint is equal to Shiva and Vishnu and destroys dull vision.

kul-p61-v1508.plain_english: He is affectionate to true devotees, steadfast, compassionate, and speaks with a smile.

kul-p61-v1509.plain_english: He honors his chosen deity, guru, and elders, and is eager in worship of women.

kul-p61-v1510.plain_english: He is free from passion, aversion, fear, affliction, pride, and ego.

kul-p61-v1511.plain_english: He is content with chance gains and discriminates virtue from vice.

kul-p61-v1512.plain_english: He is endowed with all ego-state, free from dualities, and fixed in vow.

kul-p61-v1513.plain_english: The teacher is one who is not a seller of mantras, yantras, tantras, and similar things, and is endowed with wealth, knowledge, and other such qualities.

kul-p61-v1514.plain_english: Thus, O dear one, the holy teacher is said to be endowed with these characteristics.

kul-p61-v1515.plain_english: O dear one, how is he, who is space-formed, unborn, and infinite, worshipped?
kul-p61-v1515.sanskrit_cite: vyomākāro hyajo'nantaḥ sa kathaṃ pūjyate priye

kul-p61-v1516.plain_english: O goddess, when fully worshipped with devotion, he gives enjoyment and liberation.
kul-p61-v1516.sanskrit_cite: bhaktyā sampūjito devi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayacchati

kul-p61-v1517.plain_english: Therefore, in the form of the holy teacher, he protects disciples and householders.

kul-p61-v1518.plain_english: For the sake of grace to true disciples, he wanders secretly on earth.

kul-p61-v1519.plain_english: Shiva, an ocean of compassion, indeed acts in the world like one bound in samsara.

kul-p61-v1520.plain_english: Hidden, I exist on earth in the form of the teacher.

kul-p61-v1521.plain_english: O dear one, Brahma, not four-faced, is said to be the holy teacher.

kul-p61-v1522.plain_english: O Bhavani, through meritorious action, the Shiva-like one is seen in the world.

kul-p61-v1523.plain_english: The unfortunate do not see; indeed, the blind do not see the risen sun-like one.

kul-p61-v1524.plain_english: Shiva indeed is the teacher; if not, who gives enjoyment and liberation?
kul-p61-v1524.sanskrit_cite: śiva eva gururno cedbhukti mukti dadāti kaḥ

kul-p63-v1571.plain_english: A knower of mantras stated in veda, agama, and scripture is rare on earth.

kul-p63-v1572.plain_english: This guru, O goddess, is rare and removes the sorrow of disciples.

kul-p63-v1573.plain_english: He who is free from all resolves, O goddess, is the rare guru.

kul-p63-v1574.plain_english: A wise man should choose that guru alone, not another.

kul-p63-v1575.plain_english: By whose mere sight one is liberated, there is no doubt here.

The sin of such persons is as grave as killing a priest and results in disease and sorrow.
Holy places, river confluences, and purifying forests are suitable locations for practice.
A temple, the seashore, and one's own house are also suitable places for practice.
kul-p70.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: A properly accomplished act yields its intended result effortlessly and certainly.
Mantra accomplishment brings both identification with the deity and mantra-success.
Obstacles disperse before the accomplished practitioner as elephants flee from a lion.
Without protective power, one is overwhelmed by obstacles like a fawn by tigers.
The mātṛkā can be engaged either through bead-supported construction or without mental construction.
kul-p71.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: Such negative qualities characterize a practitioner unfit for mantra success.
Even vast repetition does not produce mantra success for such a practitioner.
The initial consecrations are birth, vivification, striking, and awakening in order.
Satiation, illumination, and protection are further consecrations in the sequence.
Through the ten consecrations, mantras come to full manifestation.
kul-p72.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: One should treat an enemy as friendly everywhere and in other cases.
One should avoid such a mantra that does not cause destruction.
Siddha and others should not be purified at all in woman-given or dream-obtained cases.
Siddha and others should not be purified at all in garland-mantras.
Siddha and others should not be purified at all for sapiṇḍa-letter-mantras.
kul-p73.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: the rite satisfies the tenth portion with those substances
the offering uses pleasing foods drinks and oblation substances
the procedure includes those combined practices
the kula leader performs desired rites of one's own mind
an unaccomplished rite brings a deity curse
kul-p74.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: Knowledge of baṭuka offerings enables kula actions.
Knowing the time of enjoyment, one should receive śakti.
Knowing acceptance of the three principles, one drinks kula nectar.
Knowing yoginī enjoyment and related conduct makes one a kaulika.
Knowing peaceful hymn recitation and related practice, one may be a kula teacher.
kul-p75.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: The desired result comes by the stated means rather than ritual worship.
Meditation is performed seated, after saluting the guru.
The supreme seed syllable is combined with sixteen vowels.
The form arises from the true moon disk and is bathed in nectar.
All misfortune dissolves while auspicious śrī nourishment is caused.
kul-p76.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: the rite prescribes either a thousand or five offerings
the rite is performed in a purified fire-pit
the offering is made ritually with inward attention
pacification of all sorrow occurs immediately without doubt
the list names six fragrant substances
kul-p78.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: The Parāprāsāda seed possesses a radiance comparable to the cosmic conflagration.
The Parāprāsāda seed is as fearsome as the fire of time to all beings.
The Parāprāsāda form is endowed with youthful exuberance.
The power is directed against harmful and strife-causing beings.
Various classes of malevolent supernatural beings are among those targeted.
kul-p79.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: called Śrīnātha from hidden ignorance sign
called Deva from subjugating world lives
called Bhaṭṭāraka from protection and loveliness
called Prabhu from giving enjoyment and liberation
called Yogī from being worshiped by gods
kul-p80.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: itihāsa is named from removing all sufferings
āgama is praised for declaring mahātma-tattva
śākta is named from supreme śakti presence
kaula is named from connection with all kula
tradition is declared from ascetic contemplation
kul-p81.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: The verse names the vessel by its saving function.
The wise know support as protection of what is supported.
Meat is named from its dearness to all gods.
Worship is declared from giving complete fruit.
Worship is declared from delighting all gods.
kul-p82.essence_source: derived from argmap inferences (machine-proposed; assessor review outstanding)

essence: The verse names covering and veiling as declared and spoken.
One should speak welcome and a welfare question before the deity.
The mouth rinse is said to be made with born clove and cardamom.
Arghya is called so from the giving of invaluable fruit.
The eight-limbed arghya is proclaimed with barley, fragrance, fruit, and flower.
